miscp-1.name: Ancient Mew
miscp-1.description: New Species. Little God or Evil?

base1-1.name: Alakazam
base1-1.description: Its brain can outperform a supercomputer. Its intelligence quotient is said to be 5000.

abilities.name: Damage Swap
abilities.effect: As often as you like during your turn (before your attack), you may move 1 damage counter from 1 of your Pokémon to another as long as you don't Knock Out that Pokémon. This power can't be used if Alakazam is Asleep, Confused, or Paralyzed.

attacks.name: Confuse Ray
attacks.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Confused.

base1-2.name: Blastoise
base1-2.description: A brutal Pokémon with pressurized water jets on its shell. They are used for high-speed tackles.

abilities.name: Rain Dance
abilities.effect: As often as you like during your turn (before your attack), you may attach 1 Water Energy Card to 1 of your Water Pokémon. (This doesn't use up your 1 Energy card attachment for the turn.) This power can't be used if Blastoise is Asleep, Confused, or Paralyzed.

attacks.name: Hydro Pump
attacks.effect: Does 40 damage plus 10 more damage for each attached Water Energy attached to Blastoise but not used to pay for this attack's Energy cost. Extra Water Energy after the 2nd doesn't count.

base1-3.name: Chansey
base1-3.description: A rare and elusive Pokémon that is said to bring happiness to those who manage to catch it.

attacks.name: Scrunch
attacks.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, prevent all damage done to Chansey during your opponent's next turn. (Any other effects of attacks still happen.)

attacks.name: Double-edge
attacks.effect: Chansey does 80 damage to itself.

base1-4.name: Charizard
base1-4.description: Spits fire that is hot enough to melt boulders. Known to unintentionally cause forest fires.

abilities.name: Energy Burn
abilities.effect: As often as you like during your turn (before your attack), you may turn all Energy attached to Charizard into Fire Energy for the rest of the turn. This power can't be used if Charizard is Asleep, Confused, or Paralyzed.

attacks.name: Fire Spin
attacks.effect: Discard 2 Energy cards attached to Charizard in order to use this attack.

base1-5.name: Clefairy
base1-5.description: Its magical and cute appeal has many admirers. It is rare and found only in certain areas.

attacks.name: Sing
attacks.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Asleep.

attacks.name: Metronome
attacks.effect: Choose 1 of Defending Pokémon's attacks. Metronome copies that attack except for its Energy costs and anything else required in order to use that attack, such as discarding energy cards. (No matter what type the defender is, Clefairy's type is still Colorless.)

base1-6.name: Gyarados
base1-6.description: Rarely seen in the wild. Huge and vicious, it is capable of destroying entire cities in a rage.

attacks.name: Bubblebeam
attacks.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

base1-7.name: Hitmonchan
base1-7.description: While seeming to do nothing, it fires punches in lightning-fast volleys that are impossible to see.

base1-8.name: Machamp
base1-8.description: Using its amazing muscles, it throws powerful punches that can knock its victim clear over the horizon.

abilities.name: Strikes Back
abilities.effect: Whenever your opponent's attack damages Machamp (even if Machamp is Knoced Out), this power does 10 damage to attacking Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance.) This power can't be used if Machamp is already Asleep, Confused, or Paralyzed when your opponent attacks.

base1-9.name: Magneton
base1-9.description: Formed by several Magnemites linked together. It frequently appears when sunspots flare up.

attacks.name: Thunder Wave
attacks.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

attacks.name: Selfdestruct
attacks.effect: Does 20 damage to each Pokémon on each player's Bench. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.) Magneton does 80 damage to itself.

base1-10.name: Mewtwo
base1-10.description: A scientist created this Pokémon after years of horrific gene-splicing and DNA engineering experiments.

attacks.name: Psychic
attacks.effect: Does 10 damage plus 10 more damage for each Energy card attached to the Defending Pokémon.

attacks.name: Barrier
attacks.effect: Discard 1 Energy card attached to Mewtwo in order to use this attack. During your opponent's next turn, prevent all effects of attacks, including damage, done to Mewtwo.

base1-11.name: Nidoking
base1-11.description: Uses its powerful tail in battle to smash, constrict, then break its prey's bones.

attacks.name: Thrash
attacks.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 30 damage plus 10 more damage; if tails, this attack does 30 damage and Nidoking does 10 damage to itself.

attacks.name: Toxic
attacks.effect: The Defending Pokémon is now Poisoned. It now takes 20 Poison damage instead of 10 after each player's turn (even if it was already Poisoned).

base1-12.name: Ninetales
base1-12.description: Very smart and very vengeful. Grabbing one of its many tails could result in a 1,000-year curse.

attacks.name: Lure
attacks.effect: If your opponent has any Benched Pokémon, choose 1 of them and switch it with the Defending Pokémon.

attacks.name: Fire Blast
attacks.effect: Discard 1 Energy card attached to Ninetales in order to use this attack.

base1-13.name: Poliwrath
base1-13.description: An adept swimmer at both the front crawl and breaststroke. Easily overtakes the best human swimmers.

attacks.name: Water Gun
attacks.effect: Does 30 damage plus 10 more damage for each Water Energy attached to Poliwrath but not used to pay for this attack's Energy cost. Extra Water Energy after the 2nd doesn't count.

attacks.name: Whirlpool
attacks.effect: If the Defending Pokémon has any Energy cards attached to it, choose 1 and discard it.

base1-14.name: Raichu
base1-14.description: Its long tail serves as a ground to protect itself from its own high-voltage power.

attacks.name: Agility
attacks.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, during your opponent's next turn, prevent all effects of attacks, including damage, done to Raichu.

attacks.name: Thunder
attacks.effect: Flip a coin. If tails, Raichu does 30 damage to itself.

base1-15.name: Venusaur
base1-15.description: This plant blooms when it is absorbing solar energy. It stays on the move to seek sunlight.

abilities.name: Energy Trans
abilities.effect: As often as you like during your turn (before your attack), you may take 1 Grass Energy card attached to 1 of your Pokémon and attach it to a different one. This power can't be used if Venusaur is Asleep, Confused, or Paralyzed.

base1-16.name: Zapdos
base1-16.description: A legendary bird Pokémon said to appear from clouds while wielding enormous lightning bolts.

attacks.name: Thunder
attacks.effect: Flip a coin. If tails, Zapdos does 30 damage to itself.

attacks.name: Thunderbolt
attacks.effect: Discard all Energy cards attached to Zapdos in order to use this attack.

base1-17.name: Beedrill
base1-17.description: Flies at high speed and attacks using the large, venomous stingers on its forelegs and tail.

attacks.name: Twineedle
attacks.effect: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 30 damage times the number of heads.

attacks.name: Poison Sting
attacks.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Poisoned.

base1-18.name: Dragonair
base1-18.description: A mystical Pokémon that exudes a gentle aura. Has the ability to change climate conditions.

attacks.name: Slam
attacks.effect: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 30 damage times the number of heads.

attacks.name: Hyper Beam
attacks.effect: If the Defending Pokémon has any Energy cards attached to it, choose 1 of them and discard it.

base1-19.name: Dugtrio
base1-19.description: A team of Diglett triplets. It triggers huge earthquakes by burrowing 60 miles underground.

attacks.name: Earthquake
attacks.effect: Does 10 damage to each of your own Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

base1-20.name: Electabuzz
base1-20.description: Normally found near power plants, it can wander away and cause major blackouts in cities.

attacks.name: Thundershock
attacks.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

attacks.name: Thunderpunch
attacks.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 30 damage plus 10 more damage; if tails, this attack does 30 damage and Electabuzz does 10 damage to itself.

base1-21.name: Electrode
base1-21.description: It stores electrical energy under very high pressure. It often explodes with little or no provocation.

abilities.name: Buzzap
abilities.effect: At any time during your turn (before your attack) you may Knock Out Electrode and attach it to 1 of your other Pokémon. If you do, chose a type of Energy. Electrode is now an Energy card (instead of a Pokémon) that provides 2 energy of that type. This power can't be used if Electrode is Asleep, Confused, or Paralyzed.

attacks.name: Electric Shock
attacks.effect: Flip a coin. If tails, Electrode does 10 damage to itself.

base1-22.name: Pidgeotto
base1-22.description: Very protective of its sprawling territory, this Pokémon will fiercely peck at any intruder.

attacks.name: Whirlwind
attacks.effect: If your opponent has any Benched Pokémon, he or she chooses 1 of them and switches it with the Defending Pokémon. (Do the damage before switching the Pokémon.)

attacks.name: Mirror Move
attacks.effect: If Pidgeotto was attacked last turn, do the final result of that attack on Pidgeotto to the Defending Pokémon.

base1-23.name: Arcanine
base1-23.description: A Pokémon that has been long admired for its beauty. It runs gracefully, as if on wings.

attacks.name: Flamethrower
attacks.effect: Discard 1 Energy card attached to Arcanine in order to use this attack.

attacks.name: Take Down
attacks.effect: Arcanine does 30 damage to itself.

base1-24.name: Charmeleon
base1-24.description: When it swings its burning tail, it raises the temperature to unbearably high levels.

attacks.name: Flamethrower
attacks.effect: Discard 1 Energy card attached to Charmeleon in order to use this attack.

base1-25.name: Dewgong
base1-25.description: Stores thermal energy in its body. Swims at a steady 8 knots even in intensely cold waters.

attacks.name: Ice Beam
attacks.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

base1-26.name: Dratini
base1-26.description: Long considered a mythical Pokémon until recently, when a small colony was found living underwater.

base1-27.name: Farfetch'd
base1-27.description: The sprig of green onions it holds is its weapon. This sprig is used much like a metal sword.

attacks.name: Leek Slap
attacks.effect: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing. Either way, you can't use this attack again as long as Farfetch'd stays in play (even putting Farfetch'd on the Bench won't let you use it again.)

base1-28.name: Growlithe
base1-28.description: Very protective of its territory. It will bark and bite to repel intruders from its space.

base1-29.name: Haunter
base1-29.description: Because of its ability to slip through block walls, it is said to be from another dimension.

attacks.name: Hypnosis
attacks.effect: The Defending Pokémon is now Asleep.

attacks.name: Dream Eater
attacks.effect: You can't this attack unless the Defending Pokémon is Asleep.

base1-30.name: Ivysaur
base1-30.description: When the bulb on its back grows large, the Pokémon seems to lose the ability to stand on its hind legs.

attacks.name: Poisonpowder
attacks.effect: The Defending Pokémon is now Poisoned.

base1-31.name: Jynx
base1-31.description: Merely by meditating, the Pokémon launches a powerful psychic energy attack.

attacks.name: Doubleslap
attacks.effect: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 10 damage times the number of heads.

attacks.name: Meditate
attacks.effect: Does 20 damage plus 10 more damage for each damage counter on the Defending Pokémon.

base1-32.name: Kadabra
base1-32.description: It emits special alpha waves from its body that induce headaches even to those just nearby.

attacks.name: Recover
attacks.effect: Discard 1 Energy card attached to Kadabra in order use this attack. Remove all damage counters from Kadabra.

base1-33.name: Kakuna
base1-33.description: Almost incapable of moving, this Pokémon can only harden its shell to protect itself from predators.

attacks.name: Stiffen
attacks.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, prevent all damage done to Kakuna during your opponent's next turn. (Any other effects of attacks still happen.)

attacks.name: Poisonpowder
attacks.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Poisoned.

base1-34.name: Machoke
base1-34.description: Its muscular body is so powerful that it must wear a power-save belt to help regulate its motions.

attacks.name: Karate Chop
attacks.effect: Does 50 damage minus 10 for each damage counter on Machoke.

attacks.name: Submission
attacks.effect: Machoke does 20 damage to itself.

base1-35.name: Magikarp
base1-35.description: In the distant past, it was stronger than its horribly weak descendants that exist today.

attacks.name: Flail
attacks.effect: Does 10 damage times number of damage counters on Magikarp.

base1-36.name: Magmar
base1-36.description: Its body always burns with an orange glow that enables it to hide perfectly among flames.

attacks.name: Flamethrower
attacks.effect: Discard 1 Energy card attached to Magmar in order to use this attack.

base1-37.name: Nidorino
base1-37.description: An aggressive Pokémon that is quick to attack. The horn on its head secretes a powerful venom.

attacks.name: Double Kick
attacks.effect: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 30 damage times the number of heads.

base1-38.name: Poliwhirl
base1-38.description: Capable of living in or out of water. When out of water, it sweats to keep its body slimy.

attacks.name: Amnesia
attacks.effect: Choose 1 of defenders attacks. Defender cannot use that attack next turn.

attacks.name: Doubleslap
attacks.effect: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 30 damage times number of heads.

base1-39.name: Porygon
base1-39.description: A Pokémon that consists entirely of programming code. Capable of moving freely in cyberspace.

attacks.name: Conversion 1
attacks.effect: If the Defending Pokémon has a Weakness, you may change it to a type of your choice other than Colorless.

attacks.name: Conversion 2
attacks.effect: Change Porygon's Resistance to a type of your choice other than Colorless.

base1-40.name: Raticate
base1-40.description: It uses its whiskers to maintain its balance. It seems to slow down if they are cut off.

attacks.name: Super Fang
attacks.effect: Does damage to the Defending Pokémon equal to half the Defending Pokémon's remaining HP (rounded up to the nearest 10).

base1-41.name: Seel
base1-41.description: The protruding horn on its head is very hard. This horn is used for bashing through thick ice.

base1-42.name: Wartortle
base1-42.description: Often hides in water to stalk unweary prey. When swimming quickly, it moves its ears to maintain balance.

attacks.name: Withdraw
attacks.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, prevent all damage done to Wartortle during your opponent's next turn. (Any other effects of attacks still happen.)

base1-43.name: Abra
base1-43.description: Using its ability to read minds, it will identify impending danger and teleport to safety.

attacks.name: Psyshock
attacks.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

base1-44.name: Bulbasaur
base1-44.description: A strange seed was planted on its back at birth. Thus, a plant sprouted and now grows with this Pokémon.

attacks.name: Leech Seed
attacks.effect: Unless all damage from this attack is prevented, you may remove 1 damage counter from Bulbasaur.

base1-45.name: Caterpie
base1-45.description: Its short feet are tipped with suction pads that enable it to tirelessly climb slopes and walls.

attacks.name: String Shot
attacks.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

base1-46.name: Charmander
base1-46.description: Obviously prefers hot places. If it gets caught in the rain, steam is said to spout from the tip of its tail.

attacks.name: Ember
attacks.effect: Discard 1 Energy card attached to Charmander in order to use this attack.

base1-47.name: Diglett
base1-47.description: Lives about three feet underground, where it feeds on plant roots. It sometimes appears above ground.

base1-48.name: Doduo
base1-48.description: A bird that makes up for its poor flying with its fast foot speed. Leaves giant footprints.

attacks.name: Fury Attack
attacks.effect: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 10 damage times the number of heads.

base1-49.name: Drowzee
base1-49.description: Puts enemies to sleep, then eats their dreams. Occasionally gets sick from eating bad dreams.

attacks.name: Confuse Ray
attacks.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Confused.

base1-50.name: Gastly
base1-50.description: Almost invisible, this gaseous Pokémon cloaks the target and puts it to sleep without notice.

attacks.name: Sleeping Gas
attacks.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Asleep.

attacks.name: Destiny Bond
attacks.effect: Discard 1 Energy card attached to Gastly in order to use this attack. If a Pokémon Knocks Out Gastly during your opponent's next turn, Knock Out that Pokémon.

base1-51.name: Koffing
base1-51.description: Because it stores several kinds of toxic gases in its body, it is prone to exploding without warning.

attacks.name: Foul Gas
attacks.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Poisoned; if tails, it is now Confused.

base1-52.name: Machop
base1-52.description: Loves to build its muscles. It trains in all styles of martial arts to become even stronger.

base1-53.name: Magnemite
base1-53.description: Uses anti-gravity to stay suspended. Appears without warning and uses attacks like Thunder Wave.

attacks.name: Thunder Wave
attacks.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

attacks.name: Selfdestruct
attacks.effect: Does 10 damage to each Pokémon on each player's Bench. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.) Magnemite does 40 damage to itself.

base1-54.name: Metapod
base1-54.description: It is vulnerable to attack because its shell is soft, exposing its weak and tender body.

attacks.name: Stiffen
attacks.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, prevent all damage done to Metapod during your opponent's next turn. (Any other effects of attacks still happen.)

attacks.name: Stun Spore
attacks.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

base1-55.name: Nidoran♂
base1-55.description: Stiffens its ears to sense danger. The larger, more powerful of its horns secretes venom.

attacks.name: Horn Hazard
attacks.effect: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.

base1-56.name: Onix
base1-56.description: As it grows, the stone portions of its body harden to become similar to a diamond, though colored black.

attacks.name: Harden
attacks.effect: During opponent's next turn, whenever 30 or less damage is done to Onix (after applying Weakness and Resistance), prevent that damage. (Any other effects of attacks still happen.)

base1-57.name: Pidgey
base1-57.description: A common sight in forests and woods. It flaps its wings at ground level to kick up blinding sand.

attacks.name: Whirlwind
attacks.effect: If your opponent has any Benched Pokémon, he or she chooses 1 of them and switches it with the Defending Pokémon. (Do the damage before switching the Pokémon.)

base1-58.name: Pikachu
base1-58.description: When several of these Pokémon gather, their electricity can cause lightning storms.

attacks.name: Thunder Jolt
attacks.effect: Flip a coin. If tails, Pikachu does 10 damage to itself.

base1-59.name: Poliwag
base1-59.description: Its newly grown legs prevent it from running. It appears to prefer swimming over trying to stand.

attacks.name: Water Gun
attacks.effect: Does 10 damage plus 10 damage for each Energy attached to Poliwag but not used to pay for this attack's Energy cost. Extra Energy after the end don't count.

base1-60.name: Ponyta
base1-60.description: Its hooves are 10 times harder than diamonds. It can trample anything flat in moments.

base1-61.name: Rattata
base1-61.description: Bites anything when it attacks. Small and very quick, it is a common sight in many places.

base1-62.name: Sandshrew
base1-62.description: Burrows deep underground in arid locations far from water. It only emerges to hunt for food.

attacks.name: Sand-attack
attacks.effect: If the Defending Pokémon tries to attack during your opponent's next turn, your opponent flips a coin. If tails, that attack does nothing.

base1-63.name: Squirtle
base1-63.description: After birth, its back swells and hardens into a shell. It powerfully sprays foam from its mouth.

attacks.name: Bubble
attacks.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

attacks.name: Withdraw
attacks.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, prevent all damage done to Squirtle during your opponent's next turn. (Any other effects of attacks still happen.)

base1-64.name: Starmie
base1-64.description: Its central core glows with the seven colors of the rainbow. Some people value this core as a gem.

attacks.name: Recover
attacks.effect: Discard 1 Energy card to Starmie in order to use this attack. Remove all damage counters from Starmie.

attacks.name: Star Freeze
attacks.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

base1-65.name: Staryu
base1-65.description: An enigmatic Pokémon that can effortlessly regenerate any appendage it loses in battle.

base1-66.name: Tangela
base1-66.description: Its whole body is swathed with wide vines that are similar to seaweed. These vines shake as it walks.

attacks.name: Bind
attacks.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

attacks.name: Poisonpowder
attacks.effect: The Defending Pokémon is now Poisoned.

base1-67.name: Voltorb
base1-67.description: Usually found in power plants. Easily mistaken for a Monster Ball, it has zapped many people.

base1-68.name: Vulpix
base1-68.description: At the time of birth, it has just one tail. Its tail splits from the tip as it grows older.

attacks.name: Confuse Ray
attacks.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Confused.

base1-69.name: Weedle
base1-69.description: Often found in forests, eating leaves. It has a sharp, venomous stinger on its head.

attacks.name: Poison Sting
attacks.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, Defending Pokémon is now Poisoned.

base1-70.name: Clefairy Doll
base1-70.effect: Play Clefairy Doll as if it were a Basic Pokémon. While in play, Clefairy Doll counts as a Pokémon (instead of a Trainer card). Clefairy Doll has no attacks, can't retreat, and can't be Asleep, Confused, Paralyzed, or Poisoned. If Clefairy Doll is Knocked Out, it doesn't count as a Knocked Out Pokémon. At any time during your turn before your attack, you may discard Clefairy Doll.

base1-71.name: Computer Search
base1-71.effect: Discard 2 of the other cards from your hand in order to search your deck for any card and put it into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward.

base1-72.name: Devolution Spray
base1-72.effect: Choose 1 of your own Pokémon in play and a Stage of Evolution. Discard all Evolution cards of that Stage or higher attached to that Pokémon. That Pokémon is no longer Asleep, Confused, Paralyzed, Poisoned, or anything else that might be the result of an attack (just as if you had evolved it).

base1-73.name: Impostor Professor Oak
base1-73.effect: Your opponent shuffles his or her hand into his or her deck, then draws 7 cards.

base1-74.name: Item Finder
base1-74.effect: Discard 2 of the other cards from your hand in order to put a Trainer card from your discard pile into your hand.

base1-75.name: Lass
base1-75.effect: You and your opponent show each other your hands, then shuffle all the Trainer cards from your hands into your decks.

base1-76.name: Pokémon Breeder
base1-76.effect: Put a Stage 2 Evolution card from your hand on the matching Basic Pokémon. You can only play this card when you would be allowed to evolve that Pokémon anyway.

base1-77.name: Pokémon Trader
base1-77.effect: Trade 1 of the Basic Pokémon or Evolution cards in your hand for 1 of the Basic Pokémon or Evolution cards from your deck. Show both cards to your opponent. Shuffle your deck afterward.

base1-78.name: Scoop Up
base1-78.effect: Choose 1 of your Pokémon in play and return its Basic Pokémon card to your hand. (Discard all cards attached to that card.)

base1-79.name: Super Energy Removal
base1-79.effect: Discard 1 Energy card attached to 1 of your Pokémon in order to choose 1 of your opponent's Pokémon and up to 2 Energy cards attached to it. Discard those Energy cards.

base1-80.name: Defender
base1-80.effect: Attach Defender to 1 of your Pokémon. At the end of your opponent's next turn, discard Defender. Damage done to that Pokémon by attacks is reduced by 20 (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

base1-81.name: Energy Retrieval
base1-81.effect: Trade 1 of the other cards in your hand for up to 2 basic Energy cards from your discard pile.

base1-82.name: Full Heal
base1-82.effect: Your Active Pokémon is no longer Asleep, Confused, Paralyzed, or Poisoned.

base1-83.name: Maintenance
base1-83.effect: Shuffle 2 of the other cards from your hand into your deck in order to draw a card.

base1-84.name: PlusPower
base1-84.effect: Attach PlusPower to your Active Pokémon. At the end of your turn, discard PlusPower. If this Pokémon's attack does damage to the Defending Pokémon (after applying Weakness and Resistance), the attack does 10 more damage to the Defending Pokémon.

base1-85.name: Pokémon Center
base1-85.effect: Remove all damage counters from all of your own Pokémon with damage counters on them, then discard all Energy cards attached to those Pokémon.

base1-86.name: Pokémon Flute
base1-86.effect: Choose 1 Basic Pokémon card from your opponent's discard pile and put it onto his or her Bench. (You can't play Pokémon Flute if your opponent's Bench is full.)

base1-87.name: Pokédex
base1-87.effect: Look at up to 5 cards from the top of your deck and rearrange them as you like.

base1-88.name: Professor Oak
base1-88.effect: Discard your hand, then draw 7 cards.

base1-89.name: Revive
base1-89.effect: Put 1 Basic Pokémon card from your discard pile onto your Bench. Put damage counters on that Pokémon equal to half its HP (rounded down to the nearest 10). (You can't play Revive if your Bench is full.)

base1-90.name: Super Potion
base1-90.effect: Discard 1 Energy card attached to your own Pokémon in order to remove up to 4 damage counters from that Pokémon.

base1-92.name: Energy Removal
base1-92.effect: Choose 1 Energy card attached to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon and discard it.

base1-93.name: Gust of Wind
base1-93.effect: Choose 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon and switch it with his or her Active Pokémon.

base1-94.name: Potion
base1-94.effect: Remove up to 2 damage counters from 1 of your Pokémon.

base1-95.name: Switch
base1-95.effect: Switch 1 of your own Benched Pokémon with your Active Pokémon.

base1-96.name: Double Colorless Energy
base1-96.effect:
Provides {C}{C} energy.
Doesn't count as a basic Energy card.

base2-1.name: Clefable
base2-1.description: A timid fairy Pokémon that is rarely seen. It will run and hide the moment it senses people.

attacks.name: Metronome
attacks.effect: Choose 1 of the Defending Pokémon's attacks. Metronome copies that attack except for its Energy costs and anything else required in order to use that attack, such as discarding Energy cards. (No matter what type the Defending Pokémon is, Clefable's type is still Colorless.)

attacks.name: Minimize
attacks.effect: All damage done by attacks to Clefable during your opponent's next turn is reduce by 20 (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

base2-2.name: Electrode
base2-2.description: It stores electrical energy under very high pressure. It often explodes with little or no provocation.

attacks.name: Chain Lightning

This counts as Ho-Oh being Knocked Out and your opponent takes a Prize card.

attacks.name: Rainbow Wing
attacks.effect: This attack does 20 damage times the number of different types of basic Energy cards attached to Ho-Oh.

dp3-11.name: Jumpluff
dp3-11.description: Blown by seasonal winds, it circles the globe, scattering cotton spores as it goes.

abilities.name: Cotton Spore
abilities.effect: Whenever Jumpluff would be damaged by your opponent's attack, flip a coin. If heads, prevent all damage done to Jumpluff by that attack.

attacks.name: Cottonweed Punch
attacks.effect: Flip 2 coins. Choose 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. For each heads, this attack does 30 damage to that Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

dp3-12.name: Lickilicky
dp3-12.description: It wraps things with its extensible tongue. Getting to close to it will leave you soaked with drool.

attacks.name: Tongue Reel
attacks.effect: Choose 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. If you choose a Benched Pokémon, switch the Defending Pokémon with that Pokémon. This attack does 20 damage to the Pokémon you chose. Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

attacks.name: Boundless Power
attacks.effect: During your next turn, Lickilicky can't attack.

dp3-13.name: Ludicolo
dp3-13.description: If it hears festive music, all its muscles fill with energy. It can't help breaking out into a dance.

abilities.name: Rain Dish
abilities.effect: At any time between turns, remove 1 damage counter from Ludicolo.

attacks.name: Nature Power
attacks.effect: If you have a Stadium card in play, this attack does 60 damage plus 20 more damage. If your opponent has a Stadium card in play, the Defending Pokémon is now Confused.

dp3-14.name: Lugia
dp3-14.description: It sleeps in a deep-sea trench. If it flaps its wings, it is said to cause a 40-day storm.

attacks.name: Silver Wing
attacks.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, choose an Energy card attached to the Defending Pokémon and return it to your opponent's hand.

attacks.name: Psychic Destruction
attacks.effect: If the Defending Pokémon has any Energy cards attached to it, this attack's base damage is 40 instead of 120.

dp3-15.name: Mew
dp3-15.description: Because it can use all kinds of moves, many scientists believe MEW to be the ancestor of Pokémon.

attacks.name: Psychic Balance
attacks.effect: If you have less cards in your hand than your opponent, draw cards until you have the same number of cards as your opponent. (If you have more or the same number of cards in your hand as your opponent, this attack does nothing.)

attacks.name: Re-creation
attacks.effect: Choose an attack on 1 of your opponent's Pokémon in his or her discard pile. Re-creation copies that attack except for its Energy cost. (You must still do anything else required for that attack.) Mew performs that attack.

dp3-16.name: Raikou
dp3-16.description: It is said to have fallen with lightning. It can fire thunderbolts from the rain clouds on its back.

abilities.name: Thunder Rumble
abilities.effect: Once during your turn (before your attack), when you attach a Lightning Energy card from your hand to Raikou, you may put 1 damage counter on 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon.

attacks.name: Thunder Climb
attacks.effect: Discard 3 cards from the top of your deck. This attack does 50 damage plus 10 more damage for each Lightning Energy card you discarded. Then, attach those Lightning Energy cards to 1 of your Pokémon.

dp3-17.name: Roserade
dp3-17.description: It attracts prey with a sweet aroma, then downs it with thorny whips hidden in its arms.

attacks.name: Sleep Poison
attacks.effect: The Defending Pokémon is now Asleep and Poisoned.

attacks.name: Magical Leaf
attacks.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 40 damage plus 30 more damage and remove 3 damage counters from Roserade.

dp3-18.name: Salamence
dp3-18.description: As a result of its long-held dream of flying, its cellular structure changes, and wings grew out.

attacks.name: Direct Hit
attacks.effect: This attack's damage isn't affected by Weakness, Resistance, Poké-Powers, Poké-Bodies, or any other effects on the Defending Pokémon.

attacks.name: Dragon Finish
attacks.effect: Discard 2 basic Fire Energy cards or 2 basic Water Energy cards attached to Salamence. If you discarded 2 basic Fire Energy cards, this attack does 100 damage to the Defending Pokémon. If you discarded 2 basic Water Energy cards, this attack does 100 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.) (If you can't discard cards, this attack does nothing.)

dp3-19.name: Suicune
dp3-19.description: It races around the world to purify fouled water. It dashes away with the north wind.

abilities.name: Aqua Recovery
abilities.effect: Once during your turn, when you put Suicune from your hand onto your Bench, you may search your discard pile for up to 3 Water Pokémon, show them to your opponent, and put them into your hand.

attacks.name: Cure Stream
attacks.effect: During your opponent's next turn, any damage done by attacks from the Defending Pokémon is reduced by 20 (before applying Weakness and Resistance).

dp3-20.name: Venusaur
dp3-20.description: After a rainy day, the flower on its back smells stronger. The scent attracts other Pokémon.

abilities.name: Miracle Aroma
abilities.effect: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may flip a coin. If heads, choose either Asleep, Burned, or Poisoned. The Defending Pokémon is now affected by that Special Condition. This power can't be used if Venusaur is affected by a Special Condition.

attacks.name: Giant Bloom
attacks.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, remove 4 damage counters from Venusaur.

dp3-21.name: Absol
dp3-21.description: It senses disasters coming and appears before people only to warn them of impending danger.

attacks.name: Baleful Wind
attacks.effect: Choose a card from your opponent's hand without looking and discard it. If you discarded a Trainer, Supporter, or Stadium card, choose 1 more card from your opponent's hand without looking and discard it.

attacks.name: Dark Raid
attacks.effect: If you played Absol from your hand during this turn, this attack's base damage is 40 instead of 10.

dp3-22.name: Arcanine
dp3-22.description: Its proud and regal appearance has captured the hearts of people since long ago.

abilities.name: Flame Dash
abilities.effect: Once during your turn, when you play Arcanine from your hand to evolve 1 of your Benched Pokémon, you may switch Arcanine with 1 of your Active Pokémon. If you do, you may move any number of Energy cards attached to that Pokémon to Arcanine.

attacks.name: Inferno Onrush
attacks.effect: Arcanine does 40 damage to itself.

dp3-23.name: Banette
dp3-23.description: A doll that became a Pokémon over its grudge from being junked. It seeks the child that disowned it.

attacks.name: Ghost Head
attacks.effect: Put as many damage counters as you like on Banette. (You can't put more than Banette's remaining HP.) Put that many damage counters on the Defending Pokémon.

attacks.name: Spiteful Pain
attacks.effect: If Banette is in your discard pile, this attack does 40 damage plus 40 more damage. Then, search your discard pile for Banette, show it to your opponent, and shuffle it into your deck.

dp3-24.name: Dugtrio
dp3-24.description: Its three heads moves alternately, driving it through tough soil to depths of over 60 miles.

attacks.name: Dig Trap
attacks.effect: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing. If heads, prevent all effects of an attack, including damage, done to Dugtrio during your opponent's next turn. If Dugtrio is your Active Pokémon at the end of your opponent's next turn, put 6 damage counters on 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon.

attacks.name: Pit Trap
attacks.effect: Your opponent flips a coin. If tails, this attack does 50 damage plus 50 more damage.

dp3-25.name: Electivire
dp3-25.description: It pushes the tips of its two tails against the foe, then lets loose with over 20,000 volts of power.

abilities.name: Motor Drive
abilities.effect: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may search your discard pile for a Lightning Energy card and attach it to Electivire. This power can't be used if Electivire is affected by a Special Condition.

attacks.name: Discharge
attacks.effect: Discard all Lightning Energy attached to Electivire. Flip a coin for each Lightning Energy you discarded. This attack does 50 damage times the number of heads.

dp3-26.name: Electrode
dp3-26.description: It is known to drift on winds if it is bloated to bursting with stored electricity.

abilities.name: Energy Shift
abilities.effect: Once during your turn, if Electrode would be Knocked Out by damage from an attack, you may use this power. Electrode isn't discarded. Instead, attach it as an Energy card to 1 of your Pokémon. While attached, this card is a Special Energy card and provides every type of Energy but provides only 1 Energy at a time. (Has no effect other than providing Energy.)

attacks.name: Ion Blast
attacks.effect: You may do 40 damage plus 60 more damage. If you do, Electrode does 100 damage to itself.

dp3-27.name: Furret
dp3-27.description: The mother puts its offspring to sleep by curling up around them. It corners foes with speed.

attacks.effect: Search your deck for up to 2 cards and put them into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward.

attacks.name: Baton Pass
attacks.effect: You may switch Furret with 1 of your Benched Pokémon. If you do, move as many Energy cards attached to Furret as you like to the new Active Pokémon.

dp3-28.name: Golduck

attacks.name: Break Beam
attacks.effect: You may do 40 damage plus 20 more damage. If you do, Golduck is now Confused.

dp3-29.name: Golem
dp3-29.description: It sheds its hide once a year. Its boulderlike body is so tough, even dynamite can't harm it.

attacks.name: Megaton Rock
attacks.effect: You may do 40 damage instead of 80 to the Defending Pokémon. If you do, during your opponent's next turn, any damage done to Golem by attacks is reduced by 40 (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

dp3-30.name: Jynx

dp3-31.name: Magmortar
dp3-31.description: It blasts fireballs of over 3,600 degrees F from the ends of its arms. It lives in volcanic craters.

attacks.name: Flame Blast
attacks.effect: Does 20 damage times the number of Fire Energy attached to Magmortar.

attacks.name: Fireball Bazooka
attacks.effect: Does 20 damage to 2 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

dp3-32.name: Minun

attacks.name: Raging Scales

dp3-34.name: Nidoking

attacks.name: Pride Attack
attacks.effect: Flip a coin for each Nidoqueen on your Bench. This attack does 60 damage plus 30 more damage for each heads.

dp3-35.name: Pidgeot

attacks.name: Mirror Move
attacks.effect: If Pidgeot was damaged by an attack during your opponent's last turn, this attack does the same amount of damage done to Pidgeot to the Defending Pokémon.

attacks.name: Whirlwind
attacks.effect: Your opponent switches the Defending Pokémon with 1 of his or her Benched Pokémon.

dp3-36.name: Plusle
dp3-36.description: It cheers on friends with pom-poms made of sparks. It drains power from telephone poles.

abilities.name: Plus Charge
abilities.effect: Once during your turn (before your attack), if any of your Pokémon were Knocked Out during your opponent's last turn, you may search your discard pile for up to 2 basic Energy cards, show them to your opponent, and put them into your hand. You can't use more than 1 Plus Charge Poké-Power each turn. This power can't be used if Plusle is affected by a Special Condition.

attacks.name: Tag Play (+)
attacks.effect: If you have Minun on your Bench, you may do 20 damage to any 1 Benched Pokémon instead. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

attacks.name: Strike Wound

dp3-38.name: Sunflora

attacks.name: Petal Dance
attacks.effect: Flip 3 coins. This attack does 30 damage times the number of heads. If you get 2 or more heads, Sunflora is now Confused.

dp3-39.name: Unown S

abilities.name: SET
abilities.effect: Once during your turn (before your attack), if you have Unown S, Unown E, and Unown T on your Bench, you may flip a coin. If heads, search your discard pile for an Energy card, show it your opponent, and put it on top of your deck.

attacks.name: Hidden Power
attacks.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Confused.

dp3-40.name: Weavile
dp3-40.description: They live in cold regions, forming groups of four or five that hunt prey with impressive coordination.

attacks.name: Shadow Charge
attacks.effect: Search your deck for up to 2 Darkness Energy cards and attach them to any of your Pokémon in any way you like. Shuffle your deck afterward.

attacks.name: Chip Off
attacks.effect: If your opponent has 6 or more cards in his or her hand, discard a number of cards without looking until your opponent has 5 cards left in his or her hand.

dp3-41.name: Wormadam Plant Cloak
dp3-41.description: When BURMY evolved, its cloak became a part of this Pokémon's body. The cloak is never shed.

abilities.name: Plant Cloak
abilities.effect: If Wormadam Plant Cloak has 2 or more Grass Energy attached to it, Wormadam Plant Cloak gets +40 HP.

attacks.name: Leaf Hurricane
attacks.effect: If the Defending Pokémon has fewer remaining HP than Wormadam Plant Cloak, the Defending Pokémon is now Confused.

dp3-42.name: Wormadam Sandy Cloak
dp3-42.description: When BURMY evolved, its cloak became a part of this Pokémon's body. The cloak is never shed.

abilities.name: Sandy Cloak
abilities.effect: Prevent all effects of attacks, excluding damage, done to Wormadam Sandy Cloak.

attacks.name: Push Over
attacks.effect: Does 40 damage plus 10 more damage for each Fighting Energy attached to Wormadam Sandy Cloak.

dp3-43.name: Wormadam Trash Cloak
dp3-43.description: When BURMY evolved, its cloak became a part of this Pokémon's body. The cloak is never shed.

abilities.name: Trash Cloak
abilities.effect: If Wormadam Trash Cloak has a Pokémon Tool card attached to it, any damage done to Wormadam Trash Cloak by attacks is reduced by 20 (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

attacks.name: Iron Tackle
attacks.effect: Wormadam Trash Cloak does 20 damage to itself.

dp3-44.name: Xatu
dp3-44.description: This odd Pokémon can see both the past and the future. It eyes the sun's movement all day.

abilities.name: Psychic Shift
abilities.effect: Once during your turn, if Xatu is on your Bench, you may choose 1 Special Condition from 1 of your Active Pokémon and remove that Special Condition. Then, 1 of the Defending Pokémon is now affected by that Special Condition.

attacks.name: Energy Singe
attacks.effect: Choose 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. This attack does 20 damage to that Pokémon plus 10 more damage for each Energy attached to it. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

dp3-45.name: Breloom
dp3-45.description: Its short arms stretch when it throws punches. Its technique is equal to that of pro boxers.

attacks.name: Drain Punch
attacks.effect: Remove from Breloom a number of damage counters equal to the amount of Energy attached to the Defending Pokémon.

attacks.name: Homing Uppercut
attacks.effect: If the Defending Pokémon's Retreat Cost is 0, this attack does 60 damage plus 60 more damage.

dp3-46.name: Charmeleon
dp3-46.description: In the rocky mountains where CHARMELEON live, their fiery tails shine at night like stars.

attacks.name: Fire Fang
attacks.effect: The Defending Pokémon is now Burned.

attacks.name: Flare Tail
attacks.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, discard a Fire Energy attached to Charmeleon and this attack does 50 damage plus 20 more damage.

dp3-47.name: Cloyster
dp3-47.description: It fights by keeping its shell tightly shut for protection and by shooting spikes to repel foes.

attacks.name: Withdraw
attacks.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, prevent all damage done to Cloyster by attacks during your opponent's next turn.

attacks.name: Spine Missile
attacks.effect: Flip 4 coins. For each heads, choose an opponent's Pokémon in play and this attack does 20 damage to those Pokémon. (You may choose the same Pokémon more than once.) (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

dp3-48.name: Donphan
dp3-48.description: It attacks by curling up, then rolling into its foe. It can blow apart a house in one hit.

attacks.name: Rapid Spin
attacks.effect: Your opponent switches the Defending Pokémon with 1 of his or her Benched Pokémon, if any. You switch Donphan with 1 of your Benched Pokémon, if any.

attacks.name: Bash In
attacks.effect: If the Defending Pokémon has a Pokémon Tool card attached to it, this attack does 70 damage plus 60 more damage.

dp3-49.name: Farfetch'd
dp3-49.description: It can't live without the stalk it holds. That's why it defends the stalk from attackers with its life.

attacks.name: Swords Dance
attacks.effect: During your next turn, Farfetch'd's Leek Slap attack's base damage is 60.

attacks.name: Leek Slap
attacks.effect: During your next turn, Farfetch'd can't use Leek Slap.

dp3-50.name: Flaaffy

attacks.name: Attract Current
attacks.effect: Search your deck for a Lightning Energy card and attach it to 1 of your Pokémon. Shuffle your deck afterward.

attacks.name: Electromagnetic Kick
attacks.effect: Flip a coin. If tails, Flaaffy does 10 damage to itself.

dp3-51.name: Ivysaur
dp3-51.description: When the bud on its back starts swelling, a sweet aroma wafts to indicate the flower's coming bloom.

attacks.name: Leech Seed
attacks.effect: Remove 1 damage counter from Ivysaur.

dp3-52.name: Kecleon
dp3-52.description: It can freely change its body's color. The zigzag pattern on its belly doesn't change, however.

abilities.name: Camouflage
abilities.effect: If any basic Energy card attached to Kecleon is the same type as the Attacking Pokémon's type, any damage done by attacks from that Pokémon to Kecleon is reduced by 40 (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

attacks.name: Blind Scratch
attacks.effect: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does no damage to the Defending Pokémon. Instead, this attack does 20 damage to 1 of your Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

dp3-53.name: Kirlia
dp3-53.description: It is highly perceptive of its Trainer's feelings. It dances when it is feeling happy.

attacks.name: Psychic Research
attacks.effect: Search your discard pile for a Supporter card and use the effect of that card as the effect of this attack. (The Supporter card remains in your discard pile.)

attacks.name: Telekinesis
attacks.effect: Choose 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. This attack does 40 damage to that Pokémon. This attack's damage isn't affected by Weakness or Resistance.

dp3-54.name: Lombre
dp3-54.description: It has a mischievous spirit. If it spots an angler, it will tug on the fishing line to interfere.

attacks.name: Torment
attacks.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent can't play any Supporter cards from his or her hand during his or her next turn.

attacks.name: Absorb
attacks.effect: Remove 2 damage counters from Lombre.

dp3-55.name: Miltank
dp3-55.description: It is said that kids who drink MILTANK's milk grow up to become hearty, healthy adults.

attacks.name: Healing Milk
attacks.effect: Flip 2 coins. For each heads, remove 3 damage counters from 1 of your Pokémon.

attacks.name: Continuous Tumble
attacks.effect: Flip a coin until you get tails. This attack does 20 damage times the number of heads.

dp3-56.name: Muk
dp3-56.description: A toxic fluids seeps from its body. The fluid instantly kills plants and trees on contact.

abilities.name: Toxic Sludge
abilities.effect: At the end of each player's turn, each of your opponent's Active Pokémon that has any Grass Energy attached to it is now Poisoned. If that Pokémon is already Poisoned, Toxic Sludge Poké-Body does nothing to that Pokémon.

attacks.name: Panic Liquid
attacks.effect: The Defending Pokémon is now Confused and can't retreat during your opponent's next turn.

dp3-57.name: Nidorino
dp3-57.description: It has a violent disposition and stabs foes with its horn, which oozes poison upon impact.

attacks.name: Spirited Drill
attacks.effect: During your next turn, each of Nidorino's attacks does 20 more damage to the Defending Pokémon (before applying Weakness and Resistance).

attacks.name: Poison Horn
attacks.effect: The Defending Pokémon is now Poisoned.

dp3-58.name: Pidgeotto
dp3-58.description: It flies over its wide territory in search of prey, downing it with its highly developed claws.

attacks.name: Quick Attack
attacks.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 30 damage plus 30 more damage.

dp3-59.name: Pinsir
dp3-59.description: It grips prey with its pincers until the prey is torn in half. What it can't tear, it tosses far.

attacks.name: Grip and Squeeze
attacks.effect: The Defending Pokémon can't retreat during your opponent's next turn.

attacks.name: Power Guillotine
attacks.effect: Flip 2 coins. If either of them is tails, this attack's base damage is 10 instead of 100.

dp3-60.name: Quagsire
dp3-60.description: It has a sluggish nature. It lies at the river's bottom, waiting for prey to stray into its mouth.

abilities.name: Aqua Healing
abilities.effect: Once during your turn (before your attack), if Quagsire is your Active Pokémon and the Defending Pokémon has any Water Energy attached to it, you may remove 3 damage counters from Quagsire.

attacks.name: Muddy Water
attacks.effect: Does 20 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

dp3-61.name: Raticate
dp3-61.description: It whittles its constantly growing fangs by gnawing on hard things. It can chew apart cinder walls.

attacks.name: Gnaw Off

attacks.name: Sucker Punch

dp3-62.name: Roselia
dp3-62.description: ROSELIA raised on clean drinking water are known to grow vividly colored flowers.

attacks.name: Sleep Powder
attacks.effect: The Defending Pokémon is now Asleep.

dp3-63.name: Sableye
dp3-63.description: It hides in the darkness of caves. Its diet of gems has transformed its eyes into gemstones.

attacks.name: Shadow Sneak

dp3-64.name: Shelgon
dp3-64.description: Within its rugged shell, its cells have begun changing. The shell peels off the instant it evolves.

attacks.effect: During your next turn, Shelgon's Protect Charge attack's base damage is 80.

attacks.name: Protect Charge

dp3-65.name: Skiploom

abilities.name: Cotton Balloon

attacks.name: U-turn

dp3-66.name: Smeargle

dp3-67.name: Smoochum

attacks.name: Psykiss

swsh4.5sv-SV062.description: When it isn't battling, it keeps Dreepy in the holes on its horns. Once a fight starts, it launches the Dreepy like supersonic missiles.

swsh4.5sv-SV063.name: Galarian Farfetch'd

swsh4.5sv-SV065.name: Galarian Yamask

swsh4.5sv-SV066.name: Galarian Runerigus

swsh4.5sv-SV067.name: Rolycoly

swsh4.5sv-SV069.name: Coalossal

swsh4.5sv-SV072.name: Clobbopus

swsh4.5sv-SV075.name: Stonjourner

swsh4.5sv-SV076.name: Koffing

swsh4.5sv-SV077.name: Galarian Weezing

swsh4.5sv-SV078.name: Galarian Zigzagoon

swsh4.5sv-SV079.name: Galarian Linoone

swsh4.5sv-SV081.name: Nickit

swsh4.5sv-SV082.name: Thievul

swsh4.5sv-SV083.name: Impidimp

swsh4.5sv-SV084.name: Morgrem

swsh4.5sv-SV085.name: Grimmsnarl

swsh5-11.name: Scatterbug

swsh5-13.name: Vivillon
