attacks.effect: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.

P-A-70.name: Alolan Ninetales
P-A-70.description: A deity resides in the snowy mountains where this Pokémon lives. In ancient times, it was worshiped as that deity's incarnation.

attacks.name: Blizzard
attacks.effect: This attack also does 20 damage to each of your opponent's Benched Pokémon.

P-A-71.name: Crabrawler
P-A-71.description:
This Pokémon punches trees and eats
the berries that drop down, training itself
and getting food at the same time.

P-A-72.name: Alolan Grimer
P-A-72.description:
There are a hundred or so of them living in
Alola's waste-disposal site. They're all hard
workers who eat a lot of trash.

attacks.name: Poison Gas
attacks.effect: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Poisoned.

P-A-73.name: Toucannon
P-A-73.description:
They smack beaks with others of their kind to communicate.
The strength and number of hits tell each other how they feel.

attacks.name: Beak Blast
attacks.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Burned.

P-A-74.name: Zeraora
P-A-74.description:
It electrifies its claws and tears its opponents
apart with them. Even if they dodge its attack,
they'll be electrocuted by the flying sparks.

abilities.name: Thunderclap Flash
abilities.effect: At the end of your first turn, take a {L} Energy from your Energy Zone and attach it to this Pokémon.

P-A-75.name: Kartana
P-A-75.description:
This Ultra Beast's body, which is as thin
as paper, is like a sharpened sword.

P-A-76.name: Blacephalon
P-A-76.description:
It slithers toward people. Then, without warning, it triggers the
explosion of its own head. It's apparently one kind of Ultra Beast.

attacks.name: Beat Punk
attacks.effect: This Pokémon also does 70 damage to itself.

P-A-77.name: Xurkitree
P-A-77.description:
Although it's alien to this world and a danger here, it's apparently
a common organism in the world where it normally lives.

attacks.name: Electronica
attacks.effect: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused.

P-A-78.name: Dawn Wings Necrozma
P-A-78.description:
Lunala no longer has a will of its own. Now under the
control of Necrozma, it continuously expels all of its energy.

attacks.name: Psychobilly
attacks.effect: This Pokémon also does 30 damage to itself.

P-A-79.name: Dusk Mane Necrozma
P-A-79.description:
This is its form while it is devouring the light of
Solgaleo. It pounces on foes and then slashes
them with the claws on its four limbs and back.

attacks.name: Black Metal
attacks.effect: Discard a {M} Energy from this Pokémon.

P-A-80.name: Stakataka
P-A-80.description:
It appeared from an Ultra Wormhole. Each one
appears to be made up of many life-forms
stacked one on top of each other.

attacks.name: Brass Rock
attacks.effect: During your opponent's next turn, this Pokémon takes −20 damage from attacks.

attacks.name: Shoegaze
attacks.effect: Discard the top 5 cards of each player's deck.

P-A-82.name: Poipole
P-A-82.description:
This Ultra Beast is well enough liked to be
chosen as a first partner in its own world.

attacks.name: 2-Step
attacks.effect: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 20 damage for each heads.

P-A-83.name: Stufful
P-A-83.description:
Its fluffy fur is a delight to pet, but carelessly reaching out
to touch this Pokémon could result in painful retaliation.

attacks.name: Plasma Hurricane
attacks.effect: Take a {L} Energy from your Energy Zone and attach it to this Pokémon.

P-A-85.name: Vanillite
P-A-85.description:
Unable to survive in hot areas, it makes itself
comfortable by breathing out air cold enough to
cause snow. It burrows into the snow to sleep.

attacks.name: Sweets Relay
attacks.effect: If 1 of your Pokémon used Sweets Relay during your last turn, this attack does 20 more damage.

P-A-86.name: Jolteon
P-A-86.description:
It concentrates the weak electric charges emitted
by its cells and launches wicked lightning bolts.

attacks.name: Beginning Bolt
attacks.effect: If this Pokémon evolved during this turn, this attack does 20 more damage.

P-A-87.name: Alcremie
P-A-87.description:
When it trusts a Trainer, it will treat them
to berries it's decorated with cream.

attacks.name: Sweets Overload
attacks.effect: This attack does 40 damage for each time your Pokémon used Sweets Relay during this game.

P-A-88.name: Dragonair
P-A-88.description:
They say that if it emits an aura from its whole
body, the weather will begin to change instantly.

attacks.name: Shed Skin
attacks.effect: Heal 30 damage from this Pokémon.

P-A-89.name: Audino
P-A-89.description:
This Pokémon has a kind heart. By touching with its feelers,
Audino can gauge other creatures' feelings and physical conditions.

attacks.name: Drain Slap
attacks.effect: Heal 10 damage from this Pokémon.

P-A-90.name: Togedemaru
P-A-90.description:
With the long hairs on its back, this Pokémon
takes in electricity from other electric Pokémon.
It stores what it absorbs in an electric sac.

attacks.name: Bristling Spikes
attacks.effect: During your opponent's next turn, if this Pokémon is damaged by an attack, do 30 damage to the Attacking Pokémon.

P-A-91.name: Greedent
P-A-91.description:
This Pokémon makes off with heaps of fallen berries by wrapping
them in its tail, which is roughly twice the length of its body.

attacks.name: Enhanced Fang
attacks.effect: If this Pokémon has a Pokémon Tool attached, this attack does 50 more damage.

P-A-92.name: Eevee
P-A-92.description:
Its ability to evolve into many forms allows it to
adapt smoothly and perfectly to any environment.

P-A-93.name: Cleffa
P-A-93.description:
According to local rumors, Cleffa are often seen
in places where shooting stars have fallen.

attacks.name: Twinkly Call
attacks.effect: Put a random Pokémon from your deck into your hand.

P-A-94.name: Horsea
P-A-94.description:
Horsea makes its home in oceans with gentle
currents. If this Pokémon is under attack, it spits
out pitch-black ink and escapes.

attacks.name: Water Arrow
attacks.effect: This attack does 10 damage to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon.

P-A-95.name: Chinchou
P-A-95.description:
Its antennae, which evolved from a fin, have both
positive and negative charges flowing through them.

attacks.name: Luring Glow
attacks.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, switch in 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon to the Active Spot.

P-A-96.name: Houndoom
P-A-96.description:
If you are burned by the flames it shoots from its
mouth, the pain will never go away.

attacks.name: Diving Swipe
attacks.effect: Discard a random card from your opponent's hand.

P-A-97.name: Kangaskhan
P-A-97.description:
Although it's carrying its baby in a pouch on
its belly, Kangaskhan is swift on its feet. It
intimidates its opponents with quick jabs.

attacks.name: Cross-Cut
attacks.effect: If your opponent's Active Pokémon is an Evolution Pokémon, this attack does 40 more damage.

attacks.name: Happy Punch
attacks.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, heal 60 damage from this Pokémon.

P-A-99.name: Marill
P-A-99.description:
The fur on its body naturally repels water. It can
stay dry even when it plays in the water.

P-A-100.name: Weavile
P-A-100.description:
Evolution made it even more devious.
It communicates by clawing signs in boulders.

A1-1.name: Bulbasaur
A1-1.description: There is a plant seed on its back right from the day this Pokémon is born. The seed slowly grows larger.

A1-2.name: Ivysaur
A1-2.description: When the bulb on its back grows large, it appears to lose the ability to stand on its hind legs.

A1-3.name: Venusaur
A1-3.description: Its plant blooms when it is absorbing solar energy. It stays on the move to seek sunlight.

attacks.name: Mega Drain
attacks.effect: Heal 30 damage from this Pokémon.

attacks.name: Giant Bloom
attacks.effect: Heal 30 damage from this Pokémon.

A1-5.name: Caterpie
A1-5.description: For protection, it releases a horrible stench from the antenna on its head to drive away enemies.

attacks.name: Find a Friend
attacks.effect: Put 1 random {G} Pokémon from your deck into your hand.

A1-6.name: Metapod
A1-6.description: It is waiting for the moment to evolve. At this stage, it can only harden, so it remains motionless to avoid attack.

A1-7.name: Butterfree
A1-7.description: In battle, it flaps its wings at great speed to release highly toxic dust into the air.

abilities.name: Powder Heal
abilities.effect: Once during your turn, you may heal 20 damage from each of your Pokémon.

A1-8.name: Weedle
A1-8.description: Often found in forests and grasslands. It has a sharp, toxic barb of around two inches on top of its head.

A1-9.name: Kakuna
A1-9.description: Almost incapable of moving, this Pokémon can only harden its shell to protect itself when it is in danger.

A1-10.name: Beedrill
A1-10.description: It has three poisonous stingers on its forelegs and its tail. They are used to jab its enemy repeatedly.

A1-11.name: Oddish
A1-11.description: If exposed to moonlight, it starts to move. It roams far and wide at night to scatter its seeds.

A1-12.name: Gloom
A1-12.description: Its pistils exude an incredibly foul odor. The horrid stench can cause fainting at a distance of 1.25 miles.

A1-13.name: Vileplume
A1-13.description: It has the world's largest petals. With every step, the petals shake out heavy clouds of toxic pollen.

attacks.name: Soothing Scent
attacks.effect: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Asleep.

A1-14.name: Paras
A1-14.description: The mushrooms, known as tochukaso, are controlling the bug. Even if the bug bugs the mushrooms, they tell it to bug off.

A1-15.name: Parasect
A1-15.description: The bug is mostly dead, with the mushroom on its back having become the main body. If the mushroom comes off, the bug stops moving.

A1-16.name: Venonat
A1-16.description: Poison oozes from all over its body. It catches small bug Pokémon at night that are attracted by light.

A1-17.name: Venomoth
A1-17.description: The wings are covered with dustlike scales. Every time it flaps its wings, it looses highly toxic dust.

attacks.name: Poison Powder
attacks.effect: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Poisoned.

A1-18.name: Bellsprout
A1-18.description: Even though its body is extremely skinny, it is blindingly fast when catching its prey.

A1-19.name: Weepinbell
A1-19.description: The leafy parts act as cutters for slashing foes. It spits a fluid that dissolves everything.

A1-20.name: Victreebel
A1-20.description: Said to live in huge colonies deep in jungles, although no one has ever returned from there.

abilities.name: Fragrance Trap
abilities.effect: If this Pokémon is in the Active Spot, once during your turn, you may switch in 1 of your opponent's Benched Basic Pokémon to the Active Spot.

A1-21.name: Exeggcute
A1-21.description: Though it may look like it's just a bunch of eggs, it's a proper Pokémon. Exeggcute communicates with others of its kind via telepathy, apparently.

A1-22.name: Exeggutor
A1-22.description: Each of Exeggutor's three heads is thinking different thoughts. The three don't seem to be very interested in one another.

attacks.name: Stomp
attacks.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 30 more damage.

attacks.name: Tropical Swing
attacks.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 40 more damage.

A1-24.name: Tangela
A1-24.description: Hidden beneath a tangle of vines that grows nonstop even if the vines are torn off, this Pokémon's true appearance remains a mystery.

attacks.name: Absorb
attacks.effect: Heal 10 damage from this Pokémon.

A1-25.name: Scyther
A1-25.description: It slashes through grass with its sharp scythes, moving too fast for the human eye to track.

A1-26.name: Pinsir
A1-26.description: These Pokémon judge one another based on pincers. Thicker, more impressive pincers make for more popularity with the opposite gender.

attacks.name: Double Horn
attacks.effect: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 50 damage for each heads.

A1-27.name: Cottonee
A1-27.description: It shoots cotton from its body to protect itself. If it gets caught up in hurricane-strength winds, it can get sent to the other side of the Earth.

A1-28.name: Whimsicott
A1-28.description: It scatters cotton all over the place as a prank. If it gets wet, it'll become too heavy to move and have no choice but to answer for its mischief.

A1-29.name: Petilil
A1-29.description: The leaves on its head grow right back even if they fall out. These bitter leaves refresh those who eat them.

attacks.name: Blot
attacks.effect: Heal 10 damage from this Pokémon.

A1-30.name: Lilligant
A1-30.description: The fragrance of the garland on its head has a relaxing effect, but taking care of it is very difficult.

attacks.name: Leaf Supply
attacks.effect: Take a {G} Energy from your Energy Zone and attach it to 1 of your Benched {G} Pokémon.

A1-31.name: Skiddo
A1-31.description: Until recently, people living in the mountains would ride on the backs of these Pokémon to traverse the mountain paths.

attacks.name: Surprise Attack
attacks.effect: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.

A1-32.name: Gogoat
A1-32.description: It can sense the feelings of others by touching them with its horns. This species has assisted people with their work since 5,000 years ago.

A1-33.name: Charmander
A1-33.description: It has a preference for hot things. When it rains, steam is said to spout from the tip of its tail.

attacks.name: Ember
attacks.effect: Discard a {R} Energy from this Pokémon.

A1-34.name: Charmeleon
A1-34.description: It has a barbaric nature. In battle, it whips its fiery tail around and slashes away with sharp claws.

A1-35.name: Charizard
A1-35.description: It spits fire that is hot enough to melt boulders. It may cause forest fires by blowing flames.

attacks.name: Fire Spin
attacks.effect: Discard 2 {R} Energy from this Pokémon.

attacks.name: Crimson Storm
attacks.effect: Discard 2 {R} Energy from this Pokémon.

A1-37.name: Vulpix
A1-37.description: While young, it has six gorgeous tails. When it grows, several new tails are sprouted.

attacks.name: Tail Whip
attacks.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon can't attack during your opponent's next turn.

A1-38.name: Ninetales
A1-38.description: It is said to live 1,000 years, and each of its tails is loaded with supernatural powers.

attacks.name: Flamethrower
attacks.effect: Discard 1 {R} Energy from this Pokémon.

A1-39.name: Growlithe
A1-39.description: It has a brave and trustworthy nature. It fearlessly stands up to bigger and stronger foes.

A1-40.name: Arcanine
A1-40.description: An ancient picture scroll shows that people were captivated by its movement as it ran through prairies.

attacks.name: Heat Tackle
attacks.effect: This Pokémon also does 20 damage to itself.

attacks.name: Inferno Onrush
attacks.effect: This Pokémon also does 20 damage to itself.

A1-42.name: Ponyta
A1-42.description: It can't run properly when it's newly born. As it races around with others of its kind, its legs grow stronger.

A1-43.name: Rapidash
A1-43.description: This Pokémon can be seen galloping through fields at speeds of up to 150 mph, its fiery mane fluttering in the wind.

A1-44.name: Magmar
A1-44.description: Magmar dispatches its prey with fire. But it regrets this habit once it realizes that it has burned its intended prey to a charred crisp.

A1-45.name: Flareon
A1-45.description: Inhaled air is carried to its flame sac, heated, and exhaled as fire that reaches over 3,000 degrees Fahrenheit.

attacks.name: Flamethrower
attacks.effect: Discard 1 {R} Energy from this Pokémon.

A1-46.name: Moltres
A1-46.description: It's one of the legendary bird Pokémon. When Moltres flaps its flaming wings, they glimmer with a dazzling red glow.

attacks.name: Sky Attack
attacks.effect: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.

attacks.name: Inferno Dance
attacks.effect: Flip 3 coins. Take an amount of {R} Energy from your Energy Zone equal to the number of heads and attach it to your Benched {R} Pokémon in any way you like.

A1-48.name: Heatmor
A1-48.description: There's a hole in its tail that allows it to draw in the air it needs to keep its fire burning. If the hole gets blocked, this Pokémon will fall ill.

A1-49.name: Salandit
A1-49.description: It taunts its prey and lures them into narrow, rocky areas where it then sprays them with toxic gas to make them dizzy and take them down.

A1-50.name: Salazzle
A1-50.description: Salazzle makes its opponents light-headed with poisonous gas, then captivates them with alluring movements to turn them into loyal servants.

A1-51.name: Sizzlipede
A1-51.description: It stores flammable gas in its body and uses it to generate heat. The yellow sections on its belly get particularly hot.

A1-52.name: Centiskorch
A1-52.description: When it heats up, its body temperature reaches about 1,500 degrees Fahrenheit. It lashes its body like a whip and launches itself at enemies.

attacks.name: Fire Blast
attacks.effect: Discard a {R} Energy from this Pokémon.

A1-53.name: Squirtle
A1-53.description: When it retracts its long neck into its shell, it squirts out water with vigorous force.

A1-54.name: Wartortle
A1-54.description: It is recognized as a symbol of longevity. If its shell has algae on it, that Wartortle is very old.

A1-55.name: Blastoise
A1-55.description: It crushes its foe under its heavy body to cause fainting. In a pinch, it will withdraw inside its shell.

attacks.name: Hydro Pump
attacks.effect: If this Pokémon has at least 2 extra {W} Energy attached, this attack does 60 more damage.

attacks.name: Hydro Bazooka
attacks.effect: If this Pokémon has at least 2 extra {W} Energy attached, this attack does 60 more damage.

A1-57.name: Psyduck
A1-57.description: It is constantly wracked by a headache. When the headache turns intense, it begins using mysterious powers.

attacks.name: Headache
attacks.effect: Your opponent can't use any Supporter cards from their hand during their next turn.

A1-58.name: Golduck
A1-58.description: When it swims at full speed using its long, webbed limbs, its forehead somehow begins to glow.

A1-59.name: Poliwag
A1-59.description: For Poliwag, swimming is easier than walking. The swirl pattern on its belly is actually part of the Pokémon's innards showing through the skin.

A1-60.name: Poliwhirl
A1-60.description: Staring at the swirl on its belly causes drowsiness. This trait of Poliwhirl's has been used in place of lullabies to get children to go to sleep.

A1-61.name: Poliwrath
A1-61.description: Its body is solid muscle. When swimming through cold seas, Poliwrath uses its impressive arms to smash through drift ice and plow forward.

abilities.name: Counterattack
abilities.effect: If this Pokémon is in the Active Spot and is damaged by an attack from your opponent's Pokémon, do 20 damage to the Attacking Pokémon.

A1-62.name: Tentacool
A1-62.description: Tentacool is not a particularly strong swimmer. It drifts across the surface of shallow seas as it searches for prey.

A1-63.name: Tentacruel
A1-63.description: When the red orbs on Tentacruel's head glow brightly, watch out. The Pokémon is about to fire off a burst of ultrasonic waves.

attacks.name: Poison Tentacles
attacks.effect: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Poisoned.

A1-64.name: Seel
A1-64.description: Thanks to its thick fat, cold seas don't bother it at all, but it gets tired pretty easily in warm waters.

A1-65.name: Dewgong
A1-65.description: It sunbathes on the beach after meals. The rise in its body temperature helps its digestion.

A1-66.name: Shellder
A1-66.description: It is encased in a shell that is harder than diamond. Inside, however, it is surprisingly tender.

A1-67.name: Cloyster
A1-67.description: Cloyster that live in seas with harsh tidal currents grow large, sharp spikes on their shells.

abilities.name: Shell Armor
abilities.effect: This Pokémon takes -10 damage from attacks.

A1-68.name: Krabby
A1-68.description: It can be found near the sea. The large pincers grow back if they are torn out of their sockets.

A1-69.name: Kingler
A1-69.description: Its large and hard pincer has 10,000-horsepower strength. However, being so big, it is unwieldy to move.

attacks.name: KO Crab
attacks.effect: Flip 2 coins. If both of them are heads, this attack does 80 more damage.

A1-70.name: Horsea
A1-70.description: Horsea makes its home in oceans with gentle currents. If this Pokémon is under attack, it spits out pitch-black ink and escapes.

A1-71.name: Seadra
A1-71.description: It's the males that raise the offspring. While Seadra are raising young, the spines on their backs secrete thicker and stronger poison.

attacks.name: Water Arrow
attacks.effect: This attack does 50 damage to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon.

A1-72.name: Goldeen
A1-72.description: Its dorsal, pectoral, and tail fins wave elegantly in water. That is why it is known as the Water Dancer.

A1-73.name: Seaking
A1-73.description: In autumn, its body becomes more fatty in preparing to propose to a mate. It takes on beautiful colors.

attacks.name: Horn Hazard
attacks.effect: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.

A1-74.name: Staryu
A1-74.description: If you visit a beach at the end of summer, you'll be able to see groups of Staryu lighting up in a steady rhythm.

A1-75.name: Starmie
A1-75.description: This Pokémon has an organ known as its core. The organ glows in seven colors when Starmie is unleashing its potent psychic powers.

A1-77.name: Magikarp
A1-77.description: An underpowered, pathetic Pokémon. It may jump high on rare occasions but never more than seven feet.

A1-78.name: Gyarados
A1-78.description: Once it appears, it goes on a rampage. It remains enraged until it demolishes everything around it.

attacks.name: Hyper Beam
attacks.effect: Discard a random Energy from your opponent's Active Pokémon.

A1-79.name: Lapras
A1-79.description: A smart and kindhearted Pokémon, it glides across the surface of the sea while its beautiful song echoes around it.

attacks.name: Hydro Pump
attacks.effect: If this Pokémon has at least 3 extra {W} Energy attached, this attack does 70 more damage.

A1-80.name: Vaporeon
A1-80.description: It lives close to water. Its long tail is ridged with a fin, which is often mistaken for a mermaid's.

attacks.name: Bubble Drain
attacks.effect: Heal 30 damage from this Pokémon.

A1-81.name: Omanyte
A1-81.description: Because some Omanyte manage to escape after being restored or are released into the wild by people, this species is becoming a problem.

A1-82.name: Omastar
A1-82.description: Weighed down by a large and heavy shell, Omastar couldn't move very fast. Some say it went extinct because it was unable to catch food.

attacks.name: Ancient Whirlpool
attacks.effect: During your opponent's next turn, the Defending Pokémon can't attack.

A1-83.name: Articuno
A1-83.description: It's said that this Pokémon's beautiful blue wings are made of ice. Articuno flies over snowy mountains, its long tail fluttering along behind it.

attacks.name: Ice Beam
attacks.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

attacks.name: Blizzard
attacks.effect: This attack also does 10 damage to each of your opponent's Benched Pokémon.

A1-85.name: Ducklett
A1-85.description: When attacked, it uses its feathers to splash water, escaping under cover of the spray.

A1-86.name: Swanna
A1-86.description: Despite their elegant appearance, they can flap their wings strongly and fly for thousands of miles.

A1-87.name: Froakie
A1-87.description: It secretes flexible bubbles from its chest and back. The bubbles reduce the damage it would otherwise take when attacked.

A1-88.name: Frogadier
A1-88.description: It can throw bubble-covered pebbles with precise control, hitting empty cans up to a hundred feet away.

A1-89.name: Greninja
A1-89.description: It creates throwing stars out of compressed water. When it spins them and throws them at high speed, these stars can split metal in two.

abilities.name: Water Shuriken
abilities.effect: Once during your turn, you may do 20 damage to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon.

A1-90.name: Pyukumuku
A1-90.description: It lives in warm, shallow waters. If it encounters a foe, it will spit out its internal organs as a means to punch them.

A1-91.name: Bruxish
A1-91.description: It grinds its teeth with great force to stimulate its brain. It fires the psychic energy created by this process from the protuberance on its head.

attacks.name: Second Strike
attacks.effect: If your opponent's Active Pokémon has damage on it, this attack does 60 more damage.

A1-92.name: Snom
A1-92.description: It eats snow that has accumulated on the ground. It prefers soft, freshly fallen snow, so it will eat its way up a mountain, aiming for the peak.

A1-93.name: Frosmoth
A1-93.description: Frosmoth senses air currents with its antennae. It sends its scales drifting on frigid air, making them fall like snow.

attacks.name: Powder Snow
attacks.effect: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Asleep.

A1-94.name: Pikachu
A1-94.description: When it is angered, it immediately discharges the energy stored in the pouches in its cheeks.

A1-95.name: Raichu
A1-95.description: Its tail discharges electricity into the ground, protecting it from getting shocked.

attacks.name: Thunderbolt
attacks.effect: Discard all Energy from this Pokémon.

attacks.name: Circle Circuit
attacks.effect: This attack does 30 damage for each of your Benched {L} Pokémon.

A1-97.name: Magnemite
A1-97.description: The electromagnetic waves emitted by the units at the sides of its head expel antigravity, which allows it to float.

A1-98.name: Magneton
A1-98.description: Three Magnemite are linked by a strong magnetic force. Earaches will occur if you get too close.

abilities.name: Volt Charge
abilities.effect: Once during your turn, you may take a {L} Energy from your Energy Zone and attach it to this Pokémon.

A1-99.name: Voltorb
A1-99.description: It rolls to move. If the ground is uneven, a sudden jolt from hitting a bump can cause it to explode.

A1-100.name: Electrode
A1-100.description: The more energy it charges up, the faster it gets. But this also makes it more likely to explode.

A1-101.name: Electabuzz
A1-101.description: Many power plants keep Ground-type Pokémon around as a defense against Electabuzz that come seeking electricity.

attacks.name: Thunder Punch
attacks.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 40 more damage. If tails, this Pokémon also does 20 damage to itself.

A1-102.name: Jolteon
A1-102.description: It concentrates the weak electric charges emitted by its cells and launches wicked lightning bolts.

attacks.name: Pin Missile
attacks.effect: Flip 4 coins. This attack does 40 damage for each heads.

A1-103.name: Zapdos
A1-103.description: This Pokémon has complete control over electricity. There are tales of Zapdos nesting in the dark depths of pitch-black thunderclouds.

attacks.name: Raging Thunder
attacks.effect: This attack also does 30 damage to 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

attacks.name: Thundering Hurricane
attacks.effect: Flip 4 coins. This attack does 50 damage for each heads.

A1-105.name: Blitzle
A1-105.description: When thunderclouds cover the sky, it will appear. It can catch lightning with its mane and store the electricity.

A1-106.name: Zebstrika
A1-106.description: When this ill-tempered Pokémon runs wild, it shoots lightning from its mane in all directions.

attacks.name: Thunder Spear
attacks.effect: This attack does 30 damage to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon.

A1-107.name: Tynamo
A1-107.description: While one alone doesn't have much power, a chain of many Tynamo can be as powerful as lightning.

A1-108.name: Eelektrik
A1-108.description: They coil around foes and shock them with electricity-generating organs that seem simply to be circular patterns.

A1-109.name: Eelektross
A1-109.description: They crawl out of the ocean using their arms. They will attack prey on shore and immediately drag it into the ocean.

attacks.name: Thunder Fang
attacks.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

A1-110.name: Helioptile
A1-110.description: When spread, the frills on its head act like solar panels, generating the power behind this Pokémon's electric moves.

A1-111.name: Heliolisk
A1-111.description: One Heliolisk basking in the sun with its frill outspread is all it would take to produce enough electricity to power a city.

attacks.name: Quick Attack
attacks.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 40 more damage.

A1-112.name: Pincurchin
A1-112.description: This Pokémon generates electricity when it digests food. It uses its five hard teeth to scrape seaweed off surfaces and eat it.

attacks.name: Thunder Shock
attacks.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

A1-113.name: Clefairy
A1-113.description: It is said that happiness will come to those who see a gathering of Clefairy dancing under a full moon.

A1-114.name: Clefable
A1-114.description: A timid fairy Pokémon that is rarely seen, it will run and hide the moment it senses people.

A1-115.name: Abra
A1-115.description: This Pokémon uses its psychic powers while it sleeps. The contents of Abra's dreams affect the powers that the Pokémon wields.

attacks.name: Teleport
attacks.effect: Switch this Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

A1-116.name: Kadabra
A1-116.description: Using its psychic power, Kadabra levitates as it sleeps. It uses its springy tail as a pillow.

A1-117.name: Alakazam
A1-117.description: It has an incredibly high level of intelligence. Some say that Alakazam remembers everything that ever happens to it, from birth till death.

attacks.name: Psychic
attacks.effect: This attack does 30 more damage for each Energy attached to your opponent's Active Pokémon.

A1-118.name: Slowpoke
A1-118.description: It is incredibly slow and dopey. It takes five seconds for it to feel pain when under attack.

A1-119.name: Slowbro
A1-119.description: When a Slowpoke went hunting in the sea, its tail was bitten by a Shellder. That made it evolve into Slowbro.

A1-120.name: Gastly
A1-120.description: It wraps its opponent in its gas-like body, slowly weakening its prey by poisoning it through the skin.

A1-121.name: Haunter
A1-121.description: It likes to lurk in the dark and tap shoulders with a gaseous hand. Its touch causes endless shuddering.

A1-122.name: Gengar
A1-122.description: To steal the life of its target, it slips into the prey's shadow and silently waits for an opportunity.

attacks.name: Bother
attacks.effect: Your opponent can't use any Supporter cards from their hand during their next turn.

abilities.name: Shadowy Spellbind
abilities.effect: As long as this Pokémon is in the Active Spot, your opponent can't use any Supporter cards from their hand.

A1-124.name: Drowzee
A1-124.description: It remembers every dream it eats. It rarely eats the dreams of adults because children's are much tastier.

A1-125.name: Hypno
A1-125.description: When it locks eyes with an enemy, it will use a mix of psi moves, such as Hypnosis and Confusion.

abilities.name: Sleep Pendulum
abilities.effect: Once during your turn, you may flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Asleep.

A1-126.name: Mr. Mime
A1-126.description: The broadness of its hands may be no coincidence—many scientists believe its palms became enlarged specifically for pantomiming.

attacks.name: Barrier Attack
attacks.effect: During your opponent's next turn, this Pokémon takes -20 damage from attacks.

A1-127.name: Jynx
A1-127.description: Its strange cries sound like human language. There are some musicians who compose songs for Jynx to sing.

attacks.name: Psychic
attacks.effect: This attack does 20 more damage for each Energy attached to your opponent's Active Pokémon.

A1-128.name: Mewtwo
A1-128.description: It was created by a scientist after years of horrific gene-splicing and DNA-engineering experiments.

attacks.name: Power Blast
attacks.effect: Discard 2 {P} Energy from this Pokémon.

attacks.name: Psydrive
attacks.effect: Discard 2 {P} Energy from this Pokémon.

A1-130.name: Ralts
A1-130.description: The horns on its head provide a strong power that enables it to sense people's emotions.

A1-131.name: Kirlia
A1-131.description: It has a psychic power that enables it to distort the space around it and see into the future.

A1-132.name: Gardevoir
A1-132.description: To protect its Trainer, it will expend all its psychic power to create a small black hole.

abilities.name: Psy Shadow
abilities.effect: Once during your turn, you may take 1 {P} Energy from your Energy Zone and attach it to the {P} Pokémon in the Active Spot.

A1-133.name: Woobat
A1-133.description: While inside a cave, if you look up and see lots of heart-shaped marks lining the walls, it's evidence that Woobat live there.

A1-134.name: Swoobat
A1-134.description: Emitting powerful sound waves tires it out. Afterward, it won't be able to fly for a little while.

A1-135.name: Golett
A1-135.description: They were sculpted from clay in ancient times. No one knows why, but some of them are driven to continually line up boulders.

A1-136.name: Golurk
A1-136.description: Artillery platforms built into the walls of ancient castles served as perches from which Golurk could fire energy beams.

attacks.name: Double Lariat
attacks.effect: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 100 damage for each heads.

A1-137.name: Sandshrew
A1-137.description: It loves to bathe in the grit of dry, sandy areas. By sand bathing, the Pokémon rids itself of dirt and moisture clinging to its body.

A1-138.name: Sandslash
A1-138.description: The drier the area Sandslash lives in, the harder and smoother the Pokémon's spikes will feel when touched.

A1-139.name: Diglett
A1-139.description: It lives about one yard underground, where it feeds on plant roots. It sometimes appears aboveground.

A1-140.name: Dugtrio
A1-140.description: Its three heads bob separately up and down to loosen the soil nearby, making it easier for it to burrow.

attacks.name: Dig
attacks.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, during your opponent’s next turn, prevent all damage from—and effects of—attacks done to this Pokémon.

A1-141.name: Mankey
A1-141.description: It lives in groups in the treetops. If it loses sight of its group, it becomes infuriated by its loneliness.

A1-142.name: Primeape
A1-142.description: It becomes wildly furious if it even senses someone looking at it. It chases anyone that meets its glare.

attacks.name: Fight Back
attacks.effect: If this Pokémon has damage on it, this attack does 60 more damage.

A1-143.name: Machop
A1-143.description: Its whole body is composed of muscles. Even though it's the size of a human child, it can hurl 100 grown-ups.

A1-144.name: Machoke
A1-144.description: Its muscular body is so powerful, it must wear a power-save belt to be able to regulate its motions.

A1-145.name: Machamp
A1-145.description: It quickly swings its four arms to rock its opponents with ceaseless punches and chops from all angles.

A1-147.name: Geodude
A1-147.description: Geodude that have lived a long life have had all their edges smoothed out until they're totally round. They also have a calm, quiet disposition.

A1-148.name: Graveler
A1-148.description: It climbs up cliffs as it heads toward the peak of a mountain. As soon as it reaches the summit, it rolls back down the way it came.

A1-149.name: Golem
A1-149.description: When Golem grow old, they stop shedding their shells. Those that have lived a long, long time have shells green with moss.

attacks.name: Double-Edge
attacks.effect: This Pokémon also does 50 damage to itself.

A1-150.name: Onix
A1-150.description: As it digs through the ground, it absorbs many hard objects. This is what makes its body so solid.

A1-151.name: Cubone
A1-151.description: When the memory of its departed mother brings it to tears, its cries echo mournfully within the skull it wears on its head.

attacks.name: Growl
attacks.effect: During your opponent’s next turn, attacks used by the Defending Pokémon do −20 damage.

A1-152.name: Marowak
A1-152.description: This Pokémon overcame its sorrow to evolve a sturdy new body. Marowak faces its opponents bravely, using a bone as a weapon.

attacks.name: Bonemerang
attacks.effect: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 80 damage for each heads.

A1-154.name: Hitmonlee
A1-154.description: This amazing Pokémon has an awesome sense of balance. It can kick in succession from any position.

attacks.name: Stretch Kick
attacks.effect: This attack does 30 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon.

A1-155.name: Hitmonchan
A1-155.description: Its punches slice the air. They are launched at such high speed, even a slight graze could cause a burn.

A1-156.name: Rhyhorn
A1-156.description: Strong, but not too bright, this Pokémon can shatter even a skyscraper with its charging tackles.

A1-157.name: Rhydon
A1-157.description: It begins walking on its hind legs after evolution. It can punch holes through boulders with its horn.

A1-158.name: Kabuto
A1-158.description: This species is almost entirely extinct. Kabuto molt every three days, making their shells harder and harder.

A1-159.name: Kabutops
A1-159.description: Kabutops slices its prey apart and sucks out the fluids. The discarded body parts become food for other Pokémon.

attacks.name: Leech Life
attacks.effect: Heal from this Pokémon the same amount of damage you did to your opponent's Active Pokémon.

A1-160.name: Mienfoo
A1-160.description: In one minute, a well-trained Mienfoo can chop with its arms more than 100 times.

A1-161.name: Mienshao
A1-161.description: When Mienshao comes across a truly challenging opponent, it will lighten itself by biting off the fur on its arms.

A1-162.name: Clobbopus
A1-162.description: It's very curious, but its means of investigating things is to try to punch them with its tentacles. The search for food is what brings it onto land.

A1-163.name: Grapploct
A1-163.description: A body made up of nothing but muscle makes the grappling moves this Pokémon performs with its tentacles tremendously powerful.

attacks.name: Knock Back

A1-164.name: Ekans
A1-164.description: By dislocating its jaw, it can swallow prey larger than itself. After a meal, it curls up and rests.

A1-165.name: Arbok

attacks.name: Corner
attacks.effect: During your opponent's next turn, the Defending Pokémon can't retreat.

A1-166.name: Nidoran♀
A1-166.description: Females are more sensitive to smells than males. While foraging, they'll use their whiskers to check wind direction and stay downwind of predators.

attacks.name: Call for Family

A1-167.name: Nidorina
A1-167.description: The horn on its head has atrophied. It's thought that this happens so Nidorina's children won't get poked while their mother is feeding them.

A1-168.name: Nidoqueen

attacks.name: Lovestrike

A1-169.description: The horn on a male Nidoran's forehead contains a powerful poison. This is a very cautious Pokémon, always straining its large ears.

A1-170.name: Nidorino
A1-170.description: With a horn that's harder than diamond, this Pokémon goes around shattering boulders as it searches for a moon stone.

A1-171.name: Nidoking
A1-171.description: When it goes on a rampage, it's impossible to control. But in the presence of a Nidoqueen it's lived with for a long time, Nidoking calms down.

attacks.name: Poison Horn

attacks.name: Poison Gas

A1-178.name: Mawile

attacks.name: Crunch

A1-179.name: Pawniard

A1-180.name: Bisharp
A1-180.description: This Pokémon commands a group of several Pawniard. Groups that are defeated in territorial disputes are absorbed by the winning side.

A1-181.name: Meltan

attacks.name: Amass

abilities.name: Hard Coat

A1-184.name: Dragonair

A1-185.name: Dragonite

A1-188.name: Pidgeot

A1-191.name: Spearow

A1-192.name: Fearow

A1-194.description: It has a very fine fur. Take care not to make it angry, or it may inflate steadily and hit with a body slam.

A1-197.description: Although its fur has many admirers, it is tough to raise as a pet because of its fickle meanness.

attacks.name: Shadow Claw

A1-198.description: The stalk this Pokémon carries in its wings serves as a sword to cut down opponents. In a dire situation, the stalk can also serve as food.

A1-199.name: Doduo

A1-210.description: This is a ferocious Pokémon from ancient times. Apparently even modern technology is incapable of producing a perfectly restored specimen.

A1-212.description: The way it brushes away grime with its tail can be helpful when cleaning. But its focus on spotlessness can make cleaning more of a hassle.

A1-213.description: Its body secretes oil that this Pokémon spreads over its nest as a coating to protect it from dust. Cinccino won't tolerate even a speck of the stuff.

A2-39.name: Floatzel
A2-39.description: With its flotation sac inflated, it can carry people on its back. It deflates the sac before it dives.

attacks.name: Jet Screw
attacks.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 30 more damage.

A2-40.name: Shellos
A2-40.description: It used to have a shell on its back long ago. This species is closely related to Pokémon like Shellder.

A2-41.name: Gastrodon
A2-41.description: They normally inhabit rocky seashores, but in times of continuous rain, they can sometimes be found in the mountains, far from the sea.

attacks.name: Muddy Water
attacks.effect: This attack also does 20 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon.

A2-42.name: Finneon
A2-42.description: The line running down its side can store sunlight. It shines vividly at night.

attacks.name: Elegant Swim
attacks.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, during your opponent's next turn, prevent all damage from—and effects of—attacks done to this Pokémon.

A2-43.name: Lumineon
A2-43.description: With its shining light, it lures its prey close. However, the light also happens to attract ferocious fish Pokémon—its natural predators.

A2-44.name: Snover
A2-44.description: During cold seasons, it migrates to the mountain's lower reaches. It returns to the snow-covered summit in the spring.

attacks.name: Ice Shard
attacks.effect: If your opponent's Active Pokémon is a {F} Pokémon, this attack does 30 more damage.

A2-45.name: Abomasnow
A2-45.description: It lives a quiet life on mountains that are perpetually covered in snow. It hides itself by whipping up blizzards.

A2-46.name: Glaceon
A2-46.description: It can control its body temperature at will. This enables it to freeze the moisture in the atmosphere, creating flurries of diamond dust.

attacks.name: Ice Beam
attacks.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

A2-47.name: Wash Rotom
A2-47.description: This Rotom has entered a washing machine. It nods with satisfaction after it floods the surrounding area.

A2-48.name: Frost Rotom
A2-48.description: This Rotom has entered a refrigerator. It leaps around gleefully after it uses cold air to freeze the area around it.

attacks.name: Blizzard
attacks.effect: This attack also does 10 damage to each of your opponent's Benched Pokémon.

attacks.name: Dimensional Storm
attacks.effect: Discard 3 {W} Energy from this Pokémon. This attack also does 20 damage to each of your opponent's Benched Pokémon.

A2-50.name: Manaphy
A2-50.description: It is born with a wondrous power that lets it bond with any kind of Pokémon.

attacks.name: Oceanic Gift
attacks.effect: Choose 2 of your Benched Pokémon. For each of those Pokémon, take a {W} Energy from your Energy Zone and attach it to that Pokémon.

A2-51.name: Magnemite
A2-51.description: The electromagnetic waves emitted by the units at the sides of its head expel antigravity, which allows it to float.

A2-52.name: Magneton
A2-52.description: Three Magnemite are linked by a strong magnetic force. Earaches will occur if you get too close.

A2-53.name: Magnezone
A2-53.description: As it zooms through the sky, this Pokémon seems to be receiving signals of unknown origin while transmitting signals of unknown purpose.

attacks.name: Thunder Blast
attacks.effect: Discard a {L} Energy from this Pokémon.

A2-54.name: Voltorb
A2-54.description: It rolls to move. If the ground is uneven, a sudden jolt from hitting a bump can cause it to explode.

attacks.name: Big Explosion
attacks.effect: This Pokémon also does 10 damage to itself.

A2-55.name: Electrode
A2-55.description: The more energy it charges up, the faster it gets. But this also makes it more likely to explode.

A2-56.name: Electabuzz
A2-56.description: Many power plants keep Ground-type Pokémon around as a defense against Electabuzz that come seeking electricity.

attacks.name: Charge

A2-57.name: Electivire
A2-57.description: The amount of electrical energy this Pokémon produces is proportional to the rate of its pulse. The voltage jumps while Electivire is battling.

attacks.name: Exciting Voltage
attacks.effect: If this Pokémon has at least 2 extra {L} Energy attached, this attack does 80 more damage.

A2-58.name: Shinx
A2-58.description: The extension and contraction of its muscles generates electricity. It glows when in trouble.

attacks.name: Hide

A2-60.name: Luxray
A2-60.description: It can see clearly through walls to track down its prey and seek its lost young.

A2-62.name: Rotom

attacks.name: Assault Laser

A2-64.name: Togetic
A2-64.description: They say that it will appear before kindhearted, caring people and shower them with happiness.

A2-65.name: Togekiss
A2-65.description: These Pokémon are never seen anywhere near conflict or turmoil. In recent times, they've hardly been seen at all.

attacks.name: Overdrive Smash
attacks.effect: During your next turn, this Pokémon's Overdrive Smash attack does +60 damage.

A2-66.name: Misdreavus
A2-66.description: This Pokémon startles people in the middle of the night. It gathers fear as its energy.

attacks.name: Magical Delusion
attacks.effect: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused.

A2-68.name: Ralts
A2-68.description: The horns on its head provide a strong power that enables it to sense people's emotions.

attacks.name: Teleport
attacks.effect: Switch this Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

A2-69.name: Kirlia
A2-69.description: It has a psychic power that enables it to distort the space around it and see into the future.

A2-70.name: Duskull
A2-70.description: If it finds bad children who won't listen to their parents, it will spirit them away—or so it's said.

A2-71.name: Dusclops
A2-71.description: It seeks drifting will-o'-the-wisps and sucks them into its empty body. What happens inside is a mystery.

A2-72.name: Dusknoir
A2-72.description: At the bidding of transmissions from the spirit world, it steals people and Pokémon away. No one knows whether it has a will of its own.

abilities.name: Shadow Void
abilities.effect: As often as you like during your turn, you may choose 1 of your Pokémon that has damage on it, and move all of its damage to this Pokémon.

A2-73.name: Drifloon
A2-73.description: It is whispered that any child who mistakes Drifloon for a balloon and holds on to it could wind up missing.

attacks.name: Expand
attacks.effect: During your opponent's next turn, this Pokémon takes −20 damage from attacks.

A2-74.description: Some say this Pokémon is a collection of souls burdened with regrets, silently drifting through the dusk.

A2-75.name: Uxie

Known as “The Being of Knowledge.” It is said
that it can wipe out the memory of those who see
its eyes.

attacks.name: Mind Boost
attacks.effect: Take a {P} Energy from your Energy Zone and attach it to Mesprit or Azelf.

A2-76.name: Mesprit
A2-76.description:
Known as “The Being of Emotion.” It taught
humans the nobility of sorrow, pain, and joy.

attacks.name: Supreme Blast
attacks.effect: You can use this attack only if you have Uxie and Azelf on your Bench. Discard all Energy from this Pokémon.

A2-77.name: Azelf
A2-77.description:
Known as “The Being of Willpower.” It sleeps at the
bottom of a lake to keep the world in balance.

attacks.name: Psychic Arrow
attacks.effect: This attack does 20 damage to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon.

A2-78.name: Giratina

A2-79.name: Cresselia

attacks.name: Moonlight Gain

A2-84.name: Gliscor

attacks.name: Acrobatics
attacks.effect: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 20 more damage for each heads.

A2-87.name: Regirock
A2-87.description: Every bit of Regirock's body is made of stone. As parts of its body erode, this Pokémon sticks rocks to itself to repair what's been lost.

abilities.name: Exoskeleton

A2-88.name: Cranidos
A2-88.description: A primeval Pokémon, it possesses a hard and sturdy skull, lacking any intelligence within.

attacks.name: Skill Dive

A2-104.description: Its constant mischief and misdeeds resulted in it being bound to an Odd Keystone by a mysterious spell.

attacks.name: Swirling Disaster

A2-105.description: After burrowing into the sand, it waits patiently for prey to come near. This Pokémon and Sizzlipede share common descent.

A2-106.name: Drapion

attacks.name: Cross Poison

attacks.name: Group Beatdown

A2-109.name: Darkrai

attacks.name: Dark Void

A2-114.name: Bastiodon
A2-114.description: The bones of its face are huge and hard, so they were mistaken for its spine until after this Pokémon was successfully restored.

abilities.name: Guarded Grill

A2-123.description: It is said that when one runs at high speed, its wings create blades of wind that can fell nearby trees.

A3-170.description: It heals the wounds of people and Pokémon by sprinkling them with its sparkling scales. This guardian deity is worshiped on Akala.

A3-172.description: This Pokémon is very friendly when it's young. Its disposition becomes vicious once it matures, but it never forgets the kindness of its master.

A3-173.name: Mudsdale

A3-178.name: Bewear
A3-178.description: Once it accepts you as a friend, it tries to show its affection with a hug. Letting it do that is dangerous—it could easily shatter your bones.

A3-179.name: Komala
A3-179.description: Komala spends its entire life sleeping. It feeds on leaves that contain a potent poison only Komala can break down.

A3-211.name: Ivysaur
A3-211.description: When the bulb on its back grows large, it appears to lose the ability to stand on its hind legs.

A3-212.name: Venusaur
A3-212.description: Its plant blooms when it is absorbing solar energy. It stays on the move to seek sunlight.

A3-213.name: Exeggcute
A3-213.description: Though it may look like it's just a bunch of eggs, it's a proper Pokémon. Exeggcute communicates with others of its kind via telepathy, apparently.

A3-214.name: Exeggutor
A3-214.description: Each of Exeggutor's three heads is thinking different thoughts. The three don't seem to be very interested in one another.

A3-215.name: Squirtle
A3-215.description: When it retracts its long neck into its shell, it squirts out water with vigorous force.

A3-216.name: Wartortle
A3-216.description: It is recognized as a symbol of longevity. If its shell has algae on it, that Wartortle is very old.

A3-217.name: Blastoise
A3-217.description: It crushes its foe under its heavy body to cause fainting. In a pinch, it will withdraw inside its shell.

attacks.name: Hydro Pump

A3-218.name: Staryu
A3-218.description: If you visit a beach at the end of summer, you'll be able to see groups of Staryu lighting up in a steady rhythm.

A3-219.name: Starmie
A3-219.description: This Pokémon has an organ known as its core. The organ glows in seven colors when Starmie is unleashing its potent psychic powers.

A3-220.name: Gastly
A3-220.description: It wraps its opponent in its gas-like body, slowly weakening its prey by poisoning it through the skin.

attacks.name: Astonish

A3-221.name: Haunter
A3-221.description: It likes to lurk in the dark and tap shoulders with a gaseous hand. Its touch causes endless shuddering.

A3-222.name: Gengar
A3-222.description: To steal the life of its target, it slips into the prey's shadow and silently waits for an opportunity.

A3-223.name: Machop
A3-223.description: Its whole body is composed of muscles. Even though it's the size of a human child, it can hurl 100 grown-ups.

A3-224.name: Machoke
A3-224.description: Its muscular body is so powerful, it must wear a power-save belt to be able to regulate its motions.

A3-225.name: Machamp
A3-225.description: It quickly swings its four arms to rock its opponents with ceaseless punches and chops from all angles.

attacks.name: Power Press

A3-226.name: Cubone
A3-226.description: When the memory of its departed mother brings it to tears, its cries echo mournfully within the skull it wears on its head.

A3-227.name: Marowak
A3-227.description: This Pokémon overcame its sorrow to evolve a sturdy new body. Marowak faces its opponents bravely, using a bone as a weapon.

A3-228.name: Jigglypuff
A3-228.description: When its huge eyes waver, it sings a mysteriously soothing melody that lulls its enemies to sleep.

A3-229.name: Wigglytuff
A3-229.description: It has a very fine fur. Take care not to make it angry, or it may inflate steadily and hit with a body slam.

A3a-1.description:
The leaves on its head grow right back even if
they fall out. These bitter leaves refresh those
who eat them.

A3a-2.name: Lilligant
A3a-2.description:
The fragrance of the garland on its head has
a relaxing effect, but taking care of it is very
difficult.

A3a-3.name: Rowlet
A3a-3.description:
It sends its feathers, which are as sharp
as blades, flying in attack. Its legs are strong,
so its kicks are also formidable.

attacks.name: Fury Attack

A3a-4.name: Dartrix
A3a-4.description:
This narcissistic Pokémon is a clean freak. If you
don't groom it diligently, it may stop listening to you.

attacks.name: Skill Dive
attacks.effect: This attack does 20 damage to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon.

A3a-5.name: Decidueye
A3a-5.description:
It nocks its arrow quills and shoots them at
opponents. When it simply can't afford to miss,
it tugs the vine on its head to improve its focus.

attacks.name: Sniping Arrow
attacks.effect: This attack does 70 damage to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon.

attacks.name: Big Beat

A3a-7.name: Pheromosa
A3a-7.description:
A life-form that lives in another world, its body
is thin and supple, but it also possesses
great power.

attacks.name: Jump Blues
attacks.effect: This attack also does 20 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon.

A3a-8.name: Kartana
A3a-8.description:
This Ultra Beast's body, which is as thin
as paper, is like a sharpened sword.

A3a-9.name: Blacephalon
A3a-9.description:
It slithers toward people. Then, without warning, it triggers the
explosion of its own head. It's apparently one kind of Ultra Beast.

attacks.name: Beat Punk
attacks.effect: This Pokémon also does 70 damage to itself.

A3a-10.name: Mantine
A3a-10.description:
If it builds up enough speed swimming, it
can jump out above the waves and glide
for over 300 feet.

A3a-11.name: Carvanha
A3a-11.description:
It won't attack while it's alone—not even if it
spots prey. Instead, it waits for other Carvanha to
join it, and then the Pokémon attack as a group.

A3a-12.name: Sharpedo
A3a-12.description:
As soon as it catches the scent of prey, Sharpedo
will jet seawater from its backside, hurtling
toward the target to attack at 75 mph.

attacks.name: Crunch
attacks.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, discard a random Energy from your opponent's Active Pokémon.

A3a-13.name: Shinx
A3a-13.description:
The extension and contraction of its muscles
generates electricity. It glows when in trouble.

A3a-14.name: Luxio
A3a-14.description:
Strong electricity courses through the tips of
its sharp claws. A light scratch causes fainting
in foes.

A3a-15.name: Luxray
A3a-15.description:
It can see clearly through walls to track down its
prey and seek its lost young.

abilities.name: Intimidating Fang
abilities.effect: As long as this Pokémon is in the Active Spot, attacks used by your opponent's Active Pokémon do −20 damage.

A3a-16.name: Blitzle
A3a-16.description:
When thunderclouds cover the sky, it will appear.
It can catch lightning with its mane and store
the electricity.

A3a-17.name: Zebstrika
A3a-17.description:
When this ill-tempered Pokémon runs wild, it
shoots lightning from its mane in all directions.

A3a-18.name: Emolga
A3a-18.description:
As Emolga flutters through the air, it crackles
with electricity. This Pokémon is cute, but it can
cause a lot of trouble.

attacks.name: Plasma Hurricane

A3a-20.name: Xurkitree
A3a-20.description:
Although it's alien to this world and a danger here, it's apparently
a common organism in the world where it normally lives.

attacks.name: Electronica
attacks.effect: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused.

A3a-21.name: Zeraora
A3a-21.description:
It electrifies its claws and tears its opponents
apart with them. Even if they dodge its attack,
they'll be electrocuted by the flying sparks.

abilities.name: Thunderclap Flash
abilities.effect: At the end of your first turn, take a {L} Energy from your Energy Zone and attach it to this Pokémon.

A3a-22.name: Clefairy
A3a-22.description:
It is said that happiness will come to those who
see a gathering of Clefairy dancing under a
full moon.

A3a-23.name: Clefable
A3a-23.description:
A timid fairy Pokémon that is rarely seen, it will
run and hide the moment it senses people.

A3a-24.name: Phantump
A3a-24.description:
With a voice like a human child's, it cries out to
lure adults deep into the forest, getting them lost
among the trees.

A3a-25.name: Trevenant
A3a-25.description:
People fear it due to a belief that it devours any
who try to cut down trees in its forest, but to the
Pokémon it shares its woods with, it's kind.

A3a-26.name: Morelull
A3a-26.description:
It scatters spores that flicker and glow. Anyone
seeing these lights falls into a deep slumber.

A3a-27.name: Shiinotic
A3a-27.description:
Its flickering spores lure in prey and put them to
sleep. Once this Pokémon has its prey snoozing,
it drains their vitality with its fingertips.

abilities.name: Illuminate
abilities.effect: Once during your turn, you may put a random Pokémon from your deck into your hand.

A3a-28.name: Meditite
A3a-28.description:
It never skips its daily yoga training. It heightens
its inner strength through meditation.

attacks.name: Trip Over
attacks.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 20 more damage.

A3a-29.name: Medicham
A3a-29.description:
Through yoga training, it gained the psychic
power to predict its foe's next move.

A3a-30.name: Baltoy
A3a-30.description:
It moves while spinning around on its single foot.
Some Baltoy have been seen spinning on
their heads.

A3a-31.name: Claydol
A3a-31.description:
This mysterious Pokémon started life as an ancient
clay figurine made over 20,000 years ago.

abilities.name: Heal Block
abilities.effect: Pokémon (both yours and your opponent's) can't be healed.

A3a-32.name: Rockruff
A3a-32.description:
This Pokémon is very friendly when it's young.
Its disposition becomes vicious once it matures,
but it never forgets the kindness of its master.

attacks.name: Lycanfang
attacks.effect: Discard a {F} Energy from this Pokémon.

A3a-34.name: Passimian
A3a-34.description:
This Pokémon battles by throwing hard berries.
It won't obey a Trainer who throws Poké Balls
without skill.

attacks.name: Let's Throw
attacks.effect: If Passimian is on your Bench, this attack does 40 more damage.

A3a-35.name: Sandygast
A3a-35.description:
If it loses its shovel, it will stick something
else—like a branch—in its head to make
do until it finds another shovel.

A3a-36.name: Palossand
A3a-36.description:
The terrifying Palossand drags smaller Pokémon
into its sandy body. Once its victims are trapped,
it drains them of their vitality whenever it pleases.

attacks.name: Sand Tomb
attacks.effect: During your opponent's next turn, the Defending Pokémon can't retreat.

A3a-37.name: Alolan Meowth
A3a-37.description:
It's accustomed to luxury because it
used to live with Alolan royalty. As a
result, it's very picky about food.

attacks.name: Meddle
attacks.effect: Discard a random Pokémon Tool card from your opponent's hand.

A3a-38.name: Alolan Persian
A3a-38.description:
The round face of Alolan Persian is considered
to be a symbol of prosperity in the Alola region,
so these Pokémon are very well cared for.

attacks.name: Fake Out
attacks.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

A3a-39.name: Sandile
A3a-39.description:
It submerges itself in sand and moves as if
swimming. This wise behavior keeps its enemies
from finding it and maintains its temperature.

A3a-40.name: Krokorok
A3a-40.description:
Protected by thin membranes, their eyes can see
even in the dead of night. They live in groups of
a few individuals.

A3a-41.name: Krookodile
A3a-41.description:
After clamping down with its powerful jaws, it
twists its body around to rip its prey in half.

attacks.name: Poaching Fangs

A3a-42.name: Nihilego
A3a-42.description:
A life-form from another world, it was dubbed
a UB and is thought to produce a
strong neurotoxin.

A3a-44.name: Poipole
A3a-44.description:
This Ultra Beast is well enough liked to be
chosen as a first partner in its own world.

attacks.name: 2-Step

A3a-45.name: Naganadel
A3a-45.description:
It stores hundreds of liters of poisonous liquid
inside its body. It is one of the organisms known
as UBs.

attacks.name: Electro House
attacks.effect: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Poisoned.

A3a-46.name: Alolan Diglett
A3a-46.description:
The metal-rich geology of this Pokémon's habitat
caused it to develop steel whiskers on its head.

attacks.name: Happened to Headbutt
attacks.effect: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.

attacks.name: Triplet Headbutt
attacks.effect: Flip 3 coins. This attack does 60 damage for each heads.

A3a-48.name: Aron
A3a-48.description:
It eats iron ore—and sometimes railroad tracks—
to build up the steel armor that protects its body.

A3a-49.name: Lairon
A3a-49.description:
It loves iron ore. Groups of them fight for territory
by bashing one another with their steel bodies.

A3a-50.name: Aggron
A3a-50.description:
Aggron has a horn sharp enough to perforate
thick iron sheets. It brings down its opponents by
ramming into them horn first.

attacks.name: Giga Impact
attacks.effect: During your next turn, this Pokémon can't attack.

A3a-51.name: Ferroseed
A3a-51.description:
It absorbs the iron it finds in the rock while clinging
to the ceiling. It shoots spikes when in danger.

A3a-52.name: Ferrothorn
A3a-52.description:
This Pokémon scrapes its spikes across rocks,
and then uses the tips of its feelers to absorb
the nutrients it finds within the stone.

abilities.name: Steel Spikes
abilities.effect: If this Pokémon is in the Active Spot and is damaged by an attack from your opponent's Pokémon, do 20 damage to the Attacking Pokémon.

A3a-53.name: Stakataka
A3a-53.description:
It appeared from an Ultra Wormhole. Each one
appears to be made up of many life-forms
stacked one on top of each other.

attacks.name: Brass Rock
attacks.effect: During your opponent's next turn, this Pokémon takes −20 damage from attacks.

A3a-54.name: Lillipup
A3a-54.description:
This Pokémon is courageous but also cautious.
It uses the soft fur covering its face to collect
information about its surroundings.

A3a-55.name: Herdier
A3a-55.description:
Herdier is a very smart and friendly Pokémon.
So much so that there's a theory that Herdier was
the first Pokémon to partner with people.

A3a-56.name: Stoutland
A3a-56.description:
These Pokémon seem to enjoy living with humans.
Even a Stoutland caught in the wild will warm up
to people in about three days.

abilities.name: Guard Dog Visage
abilities.effect: As long as this Pokémon is in the Active Spot, attacks used by your opponent's Active Pokémon cost 1 {C} more.

A3a-57.name: Stufful
A3a-57.description:
Its fluffy fur is a delight to pet, but carelessly reaching out
to touch this Pokémon could result in painful retaliation.

A3a-58.name: Bewear
A3a-58.description:
Once it accepts you as a friend, it tries to show
its affection with a hug. Letting it do that is
dangerous—it could easily shatter your bones.

attacks.name: Superpowered Hug
attacks.effect: Flip 2 coins. If both of them are heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is Knocked Out.

A3a-59.name: Oranguru
A3a-59.description:
It normally spends its time meditating in the
treetops. It throws Poké Balls and gives other
Pokémon orders as it pleases.

A3a-60.name: Type: Null
A3a-60.description:
A Pokémon weapon developed for a specific
mission, it went berserk during an experiment,
so it was cryogenically frozen.

attacks.name: Quick Blow
attacks.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 20 more damage.

A3a-61.name: Silvally
A3a-61.description:
This is its form once it has awakened and
evolved. Freed from its heavy mask, its speed is

A3b-1.name: Tropius
A3b-1.description:
It lives in tropical jungles. The bunch of fruit
around its neck is delicious. The fruit grows
twice a year.

A3b-2.name: Leafeon
A3b-2.description:
When you see Leafeon asleep in a patch of
sunshine, you'll know it is using photosynthesis
to produce clean air.

attacks.name: Leaf Blast
attacks.effect: This attack does 20 more damage for each {G} Energy attached to this Pokémon.

A3b-3.name: Bounsweet
A3b-3.description:
Its sweat is sweet, like syrup made from boiled-down
fruit. Because of this, Bounsweet was highly valued in
the past, when sweeteners were scarce.

A3b-4.name: Steenee
A3b-4.description:
Steenee spreads a sweet scent that
makes others feel invigorated. This same
scent is popular for antiperspirants.

A3b-5.name: Tsareena
A3b-5.description:
This Pokémon is proud and aggressive. However, it is
said that a Tsareena will instantly become calm if
someone touches the crown on its calyx.

attacks.name: Kick Down
attacks.effect: Your opponent reveals a random card from their hand and shuffles it into their deck.

A3b-6.name: Applin
A3b-6.description:
It grows by eating the flesh of an apple.
Applin uses its own body fluid to strengthen
the apple's skin and prevent it from rotting.

A3b-7.name: Appletun
A3b-7.description:
It feeds mainly on sweet apples. It will also eat
small bug Pokémon that are attracted by its
sweet nectar.

attacks.name: Sweets Relay
attacks.effect: If 1 of your Pokémon used Sweets Relay during your last turn, this attack does 30 more damage.

A3b-8.name: Flareon
A3b-8.description:
Inhaled air is carried to its flame sac, heated, and
exhaled as fire that reaches over 3,000 degrees
Fahrenheit.

attacks.name: Assisting Heater
attacks.effect: Take a {R} Energy from your Energy Zone and attach it to 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

abilities.name: Combust

attacks.name: Fire Spin

A3b-10.name: Torkoal
A3b-10.description:
It burns coal inside its shell for energy. It blows
out black soot if it is endangered.

attacks.name: Flamethrower
attacks.effect: Discard a {R} Energy from this Pokémon.

A3b-11.name: Litten
A3b-11.description:
If you try too hard to get close to it, it won't
open up to you. Even if you do grow close,
giving it too much affection is still a no-no.

A3b-12.name: Torracat
A3b-12.description:
Torracat will let its Trainer coddle it once they've
grown close, but it's a powerful, sharp-clawed
Pokémon, so its Trainer gets covered in scratches.

A3b-13.name: Incineroar
A3b-13.description:
Although it's rough mannered and egotistical, it
finds beating down unworthy opponents boring.
It gets motivated for stronger opponents.

attacks.name: Darkest Lariat
attacks.effect: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 100 damage for each heads.

A3b-14.name: Salandit
A3b-14.description:
It taunts its prey and lures them into narrow,
rocky areas where it then sprays them with toxic
gas to make them dizzy and take them down.

attacks.name: Ember
attacks.effect: Discard a {R} Energy from this Pokémon.

A3b-15.name: Salazzle
A3b-15.description:
Salazzle makes its opponents light-headed with
poisonous gas, then captivates them with alluring
movements to turn them into loyal servants.

A3b-16.name: Vaporeon
A3b-16.description:
It lives close to water. Its long tail is ridged with
a fin, which is often mistaken for a mermaid's.

attacks.name: Hyper Whirlpool
attacks.effect: Flip a coin until you get tails. For each heads, discard a random Energy from your opponent's Active Pokémon.

A3b-17.name: Glaceon
A3b-17.description:
It can control its body temperature at will.
This enables it to freeze the moisture in the
atmosphere, creating flurries of diamond dust.

attacks.name: Ice Blade
attacks.effect: This attack does 50 damage to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon.

A3b-18.name: Vanillite
A3b-18.description:
Unable to survive in hot areas, it makes itself
comfortable by breathing out air cold enough to
cause snow. It burrows into the snow to sleep.

attacks.name: Sweets Relay
attacks.effect: If 1 of your Pokémon used Sweets Relay during your last turn, this attack does 20 more damage.

A3b-19.name: Vanillish
A3b-19.description:
By drinking pure water, it grows its icy body.
This Pokémon can be hard to find on days with
warm, sunny weather.

attacks.name: Sweets Relay
attacks.effect: If 1 of your Pokémon used Sweets Relay during your last turn, this attack does 20 more damage.

A3b-20.name: Vanilluxe
A3b-20.description:
When its anger reaches a breaking point, this
